steps.expect: options are relevant, not generic filler.

steps.action: **Check total delivered cost.** For each candidate, include tax, shipping, wrapping, personalization, and delivery fees.
steps.expect: each option has an all-in cost.

steps.action: **Verify timing and returnability.** Confirm delivery date, pickup availability, gift receipt, exchange policy, and whether personalized items are final sale.
steps.expect: late or hard-to-return options are flagged.

steps.action: **Pick the best fit under budget.** Choose the option with the best recipient fit that stays within the all-in cap.
steps.expect: one selected gift and one backup.

steps.action: **Enter recipient and message carefully.** Use the correct address, name spelling, gift note, and hide prices if desired.
steps.expect: checkout preview shows recipient-facing details correctly.

steps.action: **Place the order after final review.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm total, arrival date, recipient address, and personalization before paying.
steps.expect: order confirmation shows the gift, total, and delivery estimate.

steps.action: **Track delivery.** Save tracking and set a reminder to confirm arrival before the occasion.
steps.expect: you can intervene if shipment stalls.

recipes.verification: The gift order confirmation shows the selected item, recipient address, estimated arrival on or before the deadline, and final total at or below the all-in budget.

recipes.title: buy a warranty only when worth it
recipes.name: buy-a-warranty-only-when-worth-it
recipes.goal: You decide whether an extended warranty or protection plan is worth buying, then either decline it or purchase it with proof of coverage and a clear claim path.

steps.action: **Record the item's real risk profile.** Note purchase price, repair cost, failure likelihood, portability, accident exposure, and how long you expect to keep it.
steps.expect: you know whether the item is cheap, durable, fragile, or expensive to repair.

steps.action: **Read the included coverage first.** Check manufacturer warranty, retailer return policy, statutory rights, and credit-card purchase protection.
steps.expect: free protections and their end dates are known.

steps.action: **Open the warranty terms, not just the sales pitch.** Read covered failures, accidental damage, deductibles, exclusions, claim limits, service provider, transferability, and cancellation terms.
steps.expect: the actual contract benefits and gaps are clear.

steps.action: **Calculate expected value.** Compare warranty cost plus deductibles against likely repair or replacement cost and your ability to self-insure.
steps.expect: the plan has a yes/no value judgment based on dollars and risk, not pressure.

steps.action: **Check overlap and timing.** Confirm whether the plan starts immediately or after manufacturer coverage and whether it duplicates card benefits.
steps.expect: you know how much additional coverage the plan truly adds.

steps.action: **Make the purchase decision.** [BRANCH: warranty is not worth it, decline and save the free warranty documents | warranty is worth it, buy only the specific plan that meets your criteria] ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before buying, confirm plan price, duration, deductible, item model, and cancellation/refund window.
steps.expect: the checkout shows either no warranty charge or the chosen plan details.

steps.action: **Save coverage proof.** If purchased, save the plan receipt, contract, claim phone/site, serial number, and registration confirmation if required.
steps.expect: you can file a claim later without searching old checkout screens.

recipes.verification: Either the warranty is declined with free coverage documented, or the purchased plan's receipt and terms are saved and show the correct item, coverage dates, deductible, claim path, and price within your maximum.

recipes.title: buy in bulk without waste
recipes.name: buy-in-bulk-without-waste
recipes.goal: You buy a bulk quantity only when the unit savings exceed storage, spoilage, cash-flow, and return risks.

steps.action: **Estimate consumption.** Calculate how many units you normally use per week or month.
steps.expect: a realistic usage rate.

steps.action: **Check shelf life and storage.** Note expiration date, freshness after opening, temperature needs, and physical storage volume.
steps.expect: a maximum usable quantity before waste.

steps.action: **Compare unit prices.** Compare bulk and non-bulk options after discounts, membership fees, shipping, and taxes.
steps.expect: the true unit savings are known.

steps.action: **Account for cash flow.** Confirm paying more upfront will not displace higher-priority expenses.
steps.expect: the bulk purchase fits the budget.

steps.action: **Choose a safe quantity.** Select the largest quantity you can use and store before degradation, not necessarily the largest package sold.
steps.expect: the chosen size has low waste risk.

steps.action: **Check return and damage policy.** Confirm whether opened, perishable, or oversized items can be returned.
steps.expect: you know the downside if the item disappoints.

steps.action: **Buy only if net savings are positive.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before checkout, confirm final total, quantity, expiration date when shown, and storage plan.
steps.expect: the receipt shows a bulk purchase that fits the usage and budget plan.

recipes.verification: The purchased bulk quantity has a lower final unit price than smaller alternatives, fits storage, can be consumed before spoilage, and stays within the purchase budget.

recipes.title: cancel a free trial before it charges
recipes.name: cancel-a-free-trial-before-it-charges
recipes.goal: You cancel a free trial before paid billing begins and preserve proof that no future charge should occur.

steps.action: **Find the billing page.** Open account settings, subscription, plan, or app-store subscription management.
steps.expect: the active trial and next billing date are visible.

steps.action: **Record current terms.** Note plan name, trial end date, price after trial, and whether canceling ends access now or at period end.
steps.expect: you know the consequence of canceling.

steps.action: **Start cancellation.** Click cancel, manage plan, or turn off renewal, following all required confirmation screens.
steps.expect: the service presents a cancellation path or retention offer.

steps.action: **Decline unwanted retention offers.** Ignore discounts, pauses, or upgrades unless you intentionally choose to continue.
steps.expect: the cancellation flow reaches a final confirmation screen.

steps.action: **Confirm cancellation.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* if cancellation ends access immediately, confirm you no longer need the trial before finalizing.
steps.expect: the account shows canceled, expires on a date, or auto-renew off.

steps.action: **Save proof.** Download or screenshot the confirmation, email, plan status, and cancellation timestamp.
steps.expect: you have evidence if a charge later appears.

steps.action: **Check the payment method.** Verify no pending or posted charge appears after the trial end date.
steps.expect: the card or wallet has no unexpected paid subscription charge.

recipes.verification: The subscription status shows canceled or auto-renew off before the paid billing date, confirmation proof is saved, and no paid charge posts after the trial deadline.

recipes.title: checkout under a budget
recipes.name: checkout-under-a-budget
recipes.goal: You complete checkout for a needed purchase only if the final charged amount stays at or below a fixed budget.

steps.action: **Write the all-in budget.** Set the maximum total you will accept before opening checkout.
steps.expect: a single number that includes every charge.

steps.action: **Add only needed items.** Put the required item or approved substitutes in the cart and remove impulse add-ons.
steps.expect: the cart contents match the shopping goal.

steps.action: **Estimate unavoidable charges.** Enter delivery address or pickup location so taxes, shipping, handling, deposits, and service fees appear.
steps.expect: the cart shows a realistic subtotal and total.

steps.action: **Apply eligible discounts.** Add legitimate coupons, account credits, gift cards, or free-shipping thresholds that do not require wasteful padding.
steps.expect: discounts appear as line items.

steps.action: **Adjust the cart if over budget.** [BRANCH: remove nonessential items | choose pickup | switch to lower-cost substitute | wait for sale]
steps.expect: the revised total is at or below budget or checkout is paused.

steps.action: **Review the final payment page.** Check item, quantity, shipping speed, delivery address, return policy, subscription status, and final total.
steps.expect: there are no surprise fees or unwanted recurring charges.

steps.action: **Submit payment only under budget.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* click place order only when the final charge is at or below the written budget.
steps.expect: order confirmation shows a charged amount within budget.

recipes.verification: The order confirmation shows the intended item set and a final charged amount less than or equal to the stated all-in budget, with no unwanted subscription or add-on.

recipes.title: choose between two similar products
recipes.name: choose-between-two-similar-products
recipes.goal: You choose between two similar products using requirements, total cost, risk, and evidence rather than brand familiarity or marketing copy.

steps.action: **Define the job to be done.** Write the specific use case, must-haves, dealbreakers, and maximum total cost.
steps.expect: a decision checklist independent of either product.

steps.action: **Normalize the specs.** Compare model numbers, size, compatibility, capacity, materials, power, warranty, and included accessories in the same format.
steps.expect: differences are visible without relying on marketing language.

steps.action: **Calculate total ownership cost.** Include purchase price, required accessories, consumables, shipping, taxes, subscriptions, maintenance, and expected replacement parts.
steps.expect: both products have an all-in cost estimate.

steps.action: **Evaluate evidence quality.** Prefer professional tests, verified owner reviews, long-term reports, and return data over sponsored blurbs.
steps.expect: known strengths and recurring complaints are listed.

steps.action: **Check support and returns.** Compare warranty length, customer support reputation, restocking fees, and return window.
steps.expect: downside risk is known for each option.

steps.action: **Score against must-haves first.** Eliminate any product that fails a requirement, then choose the better value among remaining options.
steps.expect: one product wins for explicit reasons or neither qualifies.

steps.action: **Buy the chosen product.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before paying, confirm exact model, seller, total price, and return policy.
steps.expect: the order confirmation matches the chosen product and budget.

recipes.verification: The selected product satisfies all must-have requirements, has the best justified value among the two candidates, and the order confirmation shows the exact chosen model within budget.

recipes.title: downgrade a subscription tier
recipes.name: downgrade-a-subscription-tier
recipes.goal: You move a paid subscription to the lowest tier that still supports your required use, with the new price and feature changes confirmed.

steps.action: **Inventory current usage.** Check seats, storage, projects, devices, streams, exports, or usage metrics that might exceed lower-tier limits.
steps.expect: a list of required features and quantities.

steps.action: **Compare tiers.** Read the plan comparison and downgrade terms, including feature loss, data retention, and effective date.
steps.expect: one lower tier is identified as sufficient or none qualifies.

steps.action: **Prepare for limits.** Remove unused seats, reduce storage, export data, or change settings needed to fit the lower tier.
steps.expect: the account is eligible for the target plan.

steps.action: **Start the plan change.** Open billing settings and select the lower tier or contact billing support if self-service is unavailable.
steps.expect: a preview shows the new plan and price.

steps.action: **Review billing impact.** Confirm prorated credits, next charge, renewal date, taxes, and whether annual commitments remain.
steps.expect: the financial effect is clear.

steps.action: **Confirm downgrade.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before finalizing, confirm no essential feature or data access will be lost unexpectedly.
steps.expect: the account shows the lower tier or a scheduled downgrade.

steps.action: **Verify after effective date.** Recheck features, access, and invoice once the downgrade applies.
steps.expect: required workflows still work and billing reflects the lower price.

recipes.verification: The billing page or invoice shows the lower subscription tier, new recurring price, and effective date, while all required features remain usable.

recipes.title: read a spec sheet
recipes.name: read-a-spec-sheet
recipes.goal: You read a product spec sheet well enough to confirm compatibility, performance, required accessories, and hidden limitations before buying.

steps.action: **Identify the exact model.** Record model number, generation, region, capacity, size, and condition.
steps.expect: you can distinguish this item from similar variants.

steps.action: **Find official specifications.** Prefer manufacturer pages, manuals, labels, or datasheets over marketplace summaries.
steps.expect: specs come from a source likely to be accurate.

steps.action: **Map specs to requirements.** Check dimensions, compatibility, power, inputs, materials, capacity, software support, safety certifications, and operating conditions.
steps.expect: each must-have requirement is marked pass, fail, or unclear.

steps.action: **Look for footnotes and limits.** Read small print about performance conditions, subscription requirements, regional locks, warranty exclusions, and included accessories.
steps.expect: hidden constraints are identified.

steps.action: **Check what is not included.** Confirm cables, chargers, mounting hardware, batteries, adapters, licenses, or installation kits.
steps.expect: any required add-ons are added to total cost.

steps.action: **Resolve unclear specs.** Search the manual, support forum, Q&A, or contact seller before relying on ambiguous claims.
steps.expect: unknowns are answered or treated as risks.

steps.action: **Buy only if specs pass.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before checkout, confirm the exact model in cart satisfies every must-have and remains within budget after add-ons.
steps.expect: order confirmation matches the vetted model.

recipes.verification: The final purchase or no-buy decision is based on an exact model whose official specs satisfy all must-have requirements, with required add-ons included in the total cost.

recipes.title: recover an abandoned cart discount
recipes.name: recover-an-abandoned-cart-discount
recipes.goal: You attempt to receive a legitimate abandoned-cart discount, then buy only if the delayed offer makes the purchase worthwhile.

steps.action: **Build the intended cart.** Add the exact item, size, color, and quantity you would buy at the right price.
steps.expect: the cart accurately reflects the planned purchase.

steps.action: **Enter enough contact information.** Sign in or provide email during checkout without completing payment.
steps.expect: the merchant can associate the cart with your account or email.

steps.action: **Stop before payment.** Close or leave checkout before clicking any pay or place-order button.
steps.expect: no order confirmation or charge occurs.

steps.action: **Wait through the offer window.** Monitor email, SMS, app notifications, or account messages for the period you set, often 24 to 72 hours.
steps.expect: either an abandoned-cart offer appears or the wait window expires.

steps.action: **Validate the offer.** Check expiration, exclusions, minimum spend, and whether the price beats competitors.
steps.expect: the offer's real final value is known.

steps.action: **Apply the discount and review total.** Return through the offer link or code and confirm the discount appears on the final checkout page.
steps.expect: the final cart reflects the abandoned-cart discount.

steps.action: **Order only if the target price is met.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm the final total, item, delivery date, and return terms before placing the order.
steps.expect: order confirmation shows the discounted total or no order is placed.

recipes.verification: The final order confirmation shows the intended item and abandoned-cart discount with total at or below the target price, or the purchase is intentionally abandoned with no charge.

recipes.title: set a shopping spending cap
recipes.name: set-a-shopping-spending-cap
recipes.goal: You set a hard maximum purchase amount before shopping and use it to prevent overspending during checkout or negotiation.

steps.action: **Define the purchase need.** Write the must-have features, acceptable substitutes, and deadline.
steps.expect: a clear distinction between required features and nice-to-have upgrades.

steps.action: **Calculate the true total cost.** Estimate item price, tax, shipping, platform fees, accessories, financing charges, and return costs.
steps.expect: a complete cost model rather than a sticker-price target.

steps.action: **Set the maximum all-in cap.** Choose the highest total amount you can pay without harming higher-priority obligations.
steps.expect: a single maximum number that includes every fee.

steps.action: **Set a target price below the cap.** Choose a preferred deal price that leaves room for unexpected taxes or shipping.
steps.expect: both a target price and a hard walk-away price.

steps.action: **Configure available controls.** Add a budget alert, virtual-card limit, saved-search max price, cart limit, or marketplace filter.
steps.expect: the shopping interface reinforces the cap.

steps.action: **Compare offers against the all-in number.** Include coupons, shipping speed, return policy, warranty, and restocking fees in the comparison.
steps.expect: each candidate is marked under-cap or over-cap.

steps.action: **Pause before checkout.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before paying, verify the final total is at or below the cap and that no add-ons or financing terms changed the cost.
steps.expect: the checkout total is within the written cap or the purchase is abandoned.

steps.action: **Record the result.** Save the order total or note why you walked away.
steps.expect: a clear audit trail showing whether the cap was respected.

recipes.verification: The purchase is either completed at or below the written all-in cap, or abandoned with no payment submitted once the final total exceeded that cap.

recipes.title: share a family subscription plan
recipes.name: share-a-family-subscription-plan
recipes.goal: You set up or join a legitimate family subscription plan so eligible members get access at a lower per-person cost without violating terms or exposing private data.

steps.action: **Read sharing rules.** Check household, address, age, country, and account-linking requirements.
steps.expect: you know who is eligible to join.

steps.action: **Compare total cost.** Divide the family-plan price by active members and compare against individual plans.
steps.expect: the per-person savings are clear.

steps.action: **Choose the organizer.** Select the person responsible for billing, invitations, and member removal.
steps.expect: one account owns the plan.

steps.action: **Review privacy effects.** Check whether members share purchase history, location, recommendations, storage, calendars, or parental controls.
steps.expect: every member understands what may be visible.

steps.action: **Upgrade or create the family plan.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before confirming, verify recurring price, renewal date, member limit, and eligibility.
steps.expect: the organizer account shows an active family plan.

steps.action: **Invite members through official tools.** Send invitations from the service rather than sharing passwords.
steps.expect: each invitee receives an official invitation link.

steps.action: **Confirm access and billing.** Have members accept and test access; check that old individual subscriptions are canceled if no longer needed.
steps.expect: members have access and duplicate billing is removed.

recipes.verification: The family plan billing page shows the intended organizer, recurring price, renewal date, and active eligible members; each member can access the service and duplicate individual billing is canceled.

recipes.title: subscribe and save wisely
recipes.name: subscribe-and-save-wisely
recipes.goal: You use a subscription discount only for items you will reliably consume, with reminders and controls that prevent unwanted future charges.

steps.action: **Estimate real usage.** Calculate how often you use the item and how much storage or shelf life you have.
steps.expect: a delivery frequency that will not create waste.

steps.action: **Compare subscription and one-time prices.** Include coupons, shipping, membership fees, and any discount that applies only to the first shipment.
steps.expect: the ongoing subscription value is clear.

steps.action: **Read cancellation and price-change rules.** Check whether you can skip, pause, cancel online, and whether prices can change before shipment.
steps.expect: you know how to avoid unwanted renewals.

steps.action: **Choose conservative frequency.** Select the longest interval that still prevents running out.
steps.expect: the subscription starts with low overstock risk.

steps.action: **Review the first order.** Confirm quantity, delivery date, first charge, recurring price estimate, and subscription status.
steps.expect: checkout clearly marks the order as recurring.

steps.action: **Submit only if ongoing savings are real.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before confirming, verify the first charge and next scheduled charge are acceptable.
steps.expect: subscription confirmation shows item, frequency, first charge, and next date.

steps.action: **Create management reminders.** Set reminders before the next shipment and before any first-order discount expires.
steps.expect: you will review before the next charge.

recipes.verification: The subscription confirmation shows a useful item, acceptable delivery interval, first charge within budget, known next billing date, and a reminder set before the next charge.

recipes.title: use a virtual card for online shopping
recipes.name: use-a-virtual-card-for-online-shopping
recipes.goal: You create and use a virtual payment card with spending controls so an online merchant cannot charge more than you authorized.

steps.action: **Open the virtual-card tool.** Log in to your issuer or card app and find the virtual cards, merchant cards, or temporary card section.
steps.expect: a screen where you can create or manage virtual card numbers.

steps.action: **Choose the card type.** [BRANCH: one-time purchase | subscription or repeat merchant] Use a single-use card for one checkout or a merchant-locked card for recurring charges.
steps.expect: the card control matches the purchase pattern.

steps.action: **Set a spending limit.** Set the cap slightly above the expected total including tax, tip, shipping, authorization holds, or currency conversion.
steps.expect: a maximum charge amount that covers the legitimate checkout but blocks overcharges.

steps.action: **Set an expiration or lock rule.** Use the shortest expiration that still allows shipment, hotel/car holds, or subscription renewal if needed.
steps.expect: the card will stop working after the intended purchase window.

steps.action: **Name the card clearly.** Label it with the merchant and purpose, such as "Example Store shoes August 2026".
steps.expect: the transaction will be easy to identify later.

steps.action: **Enter the virtual card at checkout.** Use the generated number, expiration, CVV, and billing address exactly as the issuer requires.
steps.expect: checkout accepts the virtual card details.

steps.action: **Confirm before placing the order.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* verify merchant, order total, spending cap, billing address, shipping address, and return terms before submitting payment.
steps.expect: the order is submitted with the virtual card and no unexpected add-ons.

steps.action: **Monitor the authorization.** Check the card app for the pending charge and lock or pause the card after the legitimate charge posts if it is no longer needed.
steps.expect: only the expected merchant charge appears under the cap.

recipes.verification: The order is paid with a virtual card whose limit and expiration match the intended purchase, and the card activity shows only the expected merchant authorization or posted charge.

recipes.title: verify a seller before buying
recipes.name: verify-a-seller-before-buying
recipes.goal: You determine whether a seller is trustworthy enough to buy from and proceed only when the account, listing, and payment path are credible.

steps.action: **Inspect the seller profile.** Check account age, completed sales, response rate, rating distribution, and whether reviews describe the same category of goods.
steps.expect: a seller history that either supports or undermines trust.

steps.action: **Read negative and neutral reviews first.** Look for repeated complaints about fake tracking, substitutions, damaged items, refund delays, or poor communication.
steps.expect: a pattern assessment rather than a simple star average.

steps.action: **Check listing consistency.** Compare title, photos, description, variants, shipping date, and return terms for contradictions.
steps.expect: a listing whose terms are internally consistent or a list of conflicts to resolve.

steps.action: **Validate the business outside the platform when relevant.** For independent stores, check domain age, contact address, refund policy, social presence, and whether copied text appears on other scam sites.
steps.expect: independent signals that the store is real or signs of a disposable storefront.

steps.action: **Message the seller with a concrete question.** Ask about availability, condition, compatibility, shipping carrier, or warranty in a way a real seller can answer.
steps.expect: a specific, timely answer that matches the listing.

steps.action: **Confirm buyer protection applies.** Verify that your item category, shipping method, and payment method are covered by the platform's dispute process.
steps.expect: a known deadline and evidence requirement if the order goes wrong.

steps.action: **Set a walk-away rule.** Decide the maximum loss you are willing to risk and the exact red flags that will stop the purchase.
steps.expect: a written decision rule before checkout pressure starts.

steps.action: **Proceed only through protected checkout.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before payment, confirm seller name, item, total price, taxes, shipping address, delivery window, and dispute coverage.
steps.expect: the order can be placed without leaving the protected platform.

recipes.verification: The purchase is either abandoned for documented seller risk or completed only with a credible seller profile, consistent listing, protected payment, and known dispute deadline.

recipes.title: cancel an online order
recipes.name: cancel-an-online-order
recipes.goal: You stop an order you no longer want before it ships, or start the correct fallback if it already shipped, and you track the refund until the money is actually back.

steps.action: **Act immediately, because cancellation is a race against fulfillment.** The window can be minutes on fast-shipping retailers.
steps.expect: you are opening the order the moment you decide to cancel.

steps.action: **Open the order and read its current status.** Look for "Processing", "Preparing to ship", "Shipped", or "Out for delivery".
steps.expect: a clear status label for the order.

steps.action: **Find the cancel control.** [BRANCH: status is Processing/Not yet shipped, a "Cancel order" or "Cancel item" button is present | status is Shipped, no cancel button exists, go to step 6]
steps.expect: either a cancel button, or confirmation that the order already shipped.

steps.action: **Cancel and choose a reason if asked.** Confirm the cancellation.
steps.expect: status changes to "Cancelled" and a cancellation email arrives.

steps.action: **Confirm no charge or that a pending authorization will drop.** A card hold from a cancelled order usually falls off in a few days without becoming a real charge.
steps.expect: the pending authorization is unchanged (it will expire) or already removed.

steps.action: **If it already shipped, switch to refuse-or-return instead of cancel.** You cannot cancel a shipped order; either refuse delivery (unopened) or accept it and start a return (see shopping/return-a-product). ⚠️ *Irreversible:* once you open or use the item, refuse-delivery is off the table and only a standard return remains.
steps.expect: a return/refuse path started with an RMA or return label.

steps.action: **Watch for the "cannot cancel, already handed to carrier" trap.** Some sites show a cancel button that then fails because a warehouse already picked the item.
steps.expect: you know whether the cancel truly took, from the status label, not just the button click.

steps.action: **Track the refund to completion.** Note the refund-issued date from the retailer, then watch your statement. Card refunds typically post in 5-10 business days.
steps.expect: the refunded amount appears on your statement matching the order value.

recipes.verification: The order shows "Cancelled" (or a return/refuse is in progress for a shipped item), and the full expected refund has posted to your original payment method within the retailer's stated window.

recipes.title: compare products before buying
recipes.name: compare-products-before-buying
recipes.goal: For a purchase that matters, you converge on the right product at a fair price in bounded time — informed enough to be confident, without falling into review-reading forever.

steps.action: **Time-box by stakes.** Cheap/reversible (< an hour's pay, returnable): 10 minutes, pick the well-reviewed default, done — over-researching these is the real loss. Expensive/long-lived (appliance, mattress, laptop): the full recipe below.
steps.expect: a conscious lane choice before any tab is opened.

steps.action: **Establish the category's landscape in one pass.** One trusted roundup/wirecutter-class source or two: learn the 3–4 usual candidates, the price tiers, and the *vocabulary* (what spec actually matters in this category vs. marketing numbers).
steps.expect: a shortlist of ~3 and knowledge of which one or two specs are load-bearing.

steps.action: **Compare the shortlist on your requirements only.** A tiny table (phone note suffices): rows = your 2–3 requirements + price; columns = candidates. Specs not on your list don't get columns — that's the discipline.
steps.expect: a table where a winner is usually visible; ties broken by the nice-to-haves, not by reopening research.

steps.action: **Read reviews for failure patterns, not scores.** Sort to critical reviews, recent first, on the finalists: repeated *specific* complaints ("hinge breaks at month 3", "runs two sizes small") are signal; lone rants and vague praise are noise. Check the review-count-to-age smell (thousands of 5-stars in a week = bought reviews).
steps.expect: each finalist's characteristic weakness known — and judged tolerable or disqualifying against *your* use.

steps.action: **Verify the price is normal, not theatrical.** A price-history check (tracker sites/extensions) or a 30-second cross-store search: is today's "40% off" the everyday price in costume?
steps.expect: the real price band known; urgency-marketing defused.

steps.action: **Decide and stop.** Buy the winner (`shopping/buy-a-product-online`), or calendar the known sale season if the history says wait. Close the tabs — post-purchase re-research has no upside.
steps.expect: a purchase (or a dated waiting plan) and the research loop actually closed.

recipes.verification: The purchase satisfies the written requirements, its characteristic weakness was known in advance, the price was sane against history, total research time matched the stakes lane — and the decision closed without a post-purchase research relapse.

recipes.title: avoid shrinkflation traps
recipes.name: avoid-shrinkflation-traps
recipes.goal: You identify when a product quietly became smaller or weaker, then choose the option with the best real value instead of the most familiar package.

steps.action: **Find the old baseline.** Check previous orders, receipts, pantry packaging, or price trackers for the former size and price.
steps.expect: an old price and old usable quantity.

steps.action: **Record the current size.** Read the current label for net weight, count, sheets, doses, active ingredient, or servings.
steps.expect: a current quantity that can be compared to the baseline.

steps.action: **Calculate the old and new unit prices.** Divide price by usable quantity for both versions, including required delivery fees if shopping online.
steps.expect: a clear percentage change in unit price.

steps.action: **Inspect quality changes.** Look for weaker concentration, fewer layers, smaller servings, thinner material, or changed ingredients.
steps.expect: any hidden performance reduction is noted.

steps.action: **Compare alternatives.** Search store brands, larger sizes, competitor products, and multipacks using the same unit-price method.
steps.expect: at least two realistic substitutes with comparable unit prices.

steps.action: **Choose or defer.** Buy the best value only if it fits your budget and usage; otherwise wait, switch brands, or buy a smaller emergency quantity. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm the product size in the cart before paying because images may show old packaging.
steps.expect: the selected item is not worse value than your acceptable threshold.

recipes.verification: The final purchase either beats the shrunken product's current unit price, stays under your maximum acceptable unit price, or is intentionally deferred with no payment made.

recipes.title: bid on an online auction
recipes.name: bid-on-an-online-auction
recipes.goal: You bid on an online auction with a pre-set maximum total cost, understand the listing risks, and either win within budget or walk away.

steps.action: **Inspect the listing thoroughly.** Read title, description, photos, condition, included parts, seller terms, return policy, shipping cost, and location.
steps.expect: you understand exactly what is being auctioned and what is uncertain.

steps.action: **Check seller and authenticity signals.** Review feedback, completed sales, dispute history if visible, serial numbers, certificates, or platform guarantees.
steps.expect: seller risk is acceptable or the auction is rejected.

steps.action: **Calculate your maximum bid from total cost.** Subtract shipping, tax, buyer premium, and fees from your maximum total.
steps.expect: a hard maximum bid amount is written down.

steps.action: **Decide bid timing and method.** [BRANCH: early proxy bid | manual late bid] Choose a strategy allowed by the platform and consistent with your max.
steps.expect: you know when and how you will bid.

steps.action: **Place a bid only within your maximum.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* bids may be binding; confirm amount, currency, item, and fees before submitting.
steps.expect: the platform accepts your bid or reports you were outbid.

steps.action: **Monitor without raising the cap emotionally.** If outbid, bid again only if the new total remains within your maximum.
steps.expect: you remain active only while under budget.

steps.action: **If you win, pay promptly through the platform.** Confirm final invoice, shipping address, and payment method. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* payment transfers funds; confirm invoice matches the auction before paying.
steps.expect: order/payment confirmation appears.

steps.action: **Track delivery and inspect on arrival.** Compare the received item to listing photos and description before the dispute window closes.
steps.expect: the item is accepted or a documented dispute is opened.

recipes.verification: You either win and pay an invoice whose total is at or below your pre-set maximum, or you lose/walk away without placing any bid above that maximum.

recipes.title: buy a refurbished device safely
recipes.name: buy-a-refurbished-device-safely
recipes.goal: You buy a refurbished device from a trustworthy source with clear condition, warranty, return rights, and post-delivery checks that catch defects early.

steps.action: **Define required specs and compatibility.** Record model number, storage/RAM, carrier bands or lock status, power plug region, operating-system support, and battery threshold.
steps.expect: you can reject incompatible listings quickly.

steps.action: **Choose reputable refurb sources.** Prefer manufacturer-certified, authorized retailer, or marketplace programs with written inspection standards, warranty, and returns.
steps.expect: candidate sellers have enforceable protections.

steps.action: **Compare refurbished, open-box, used, and new prices.** Include warranty length, return window, accessory quality, and battery replacement cost.
steps.expect: refurbished savings justify the reduced certainty versus new.

steps.action: **Inspect listing terms before checkout.** Confirm condition grade, exact SKU, included accessories, warranty provider, return window, restocking fee, and seller identity.
steps.expect: the listing meets your required specs and protection standard.

steps.action: **Pay through a protected checkout.** Avoid wire, gift card, crypto, or off-platform invoice requests. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* payment authorizes at checkout; confirm seller, model, condition, warranty, and final total first.
steps.expect: order confirmation number appears.

steps.action: **Document unboxing and device identity.** Photograph package condition, serial/IMEI where appropriate, included accessories, and any visible damage.
steps.expect: you have evidence from arrival.

steps.action: **Run functional checks immediately.** Test power, screen, keyboard/buttons, cameras, speakers, ports, battery health, network lock, activation lock, storage, and charging.
steps.expect: the device either passes your acceptance checklist or issues are documented.

steps.action: **Register warranty or start return quickly.** If the device passes, save warranty proof; if not, open return/support before the window closes.
steps.expect: warranty is active or return authorization is started.

recipes.verification: The refurbished device is purchased from an acceptable seller at or below the maximum price, passes the post-delivery functional checklist, and has an active warranty or an open return authorization.

recipes.title: buy at the price low
recipes.name: buy-at-the-price-low
recipes.goal: You buy a specific item only when its verified total price reaches a pre-defined low target, without being pulled into worse substitutes or hidden costs.

steps.action: **Define the exact item and acceptable substitutes.** Record model number, size/color, condition, warranty, seller type, delivery deadline, and excluded variants.
steps.expect: you can tell quickly whether an offer matches.

steps.action: **Set the target low as an all-in price.** Include shipping, tax, fees, required memberships, and only rewards you trust.
steps.expect: a specific maximum checkout total or net price.

steps.action: **Check current and historical prices.** Use seller sites, price trackers, sold listings, and retailer history to confirm the target is realistic.
steps.expect: the target low is justified by actual past or market prices.

steps.action: **Prepare fast checkout safely.** Log in, add shipping address, verify payment method, and save alerts without pre-authorizing unknown charges.
steps.expect: you can checkout quickly when the threshold is met.

steps.action: **Monitor trusted sources.** Use price alerts, retailer wishlists, deal forums, and stock notices for the exact item.
steps.expect: you receive actionable alerts for matching offers.

steps.action: **Validate the deal before buying.** Confirm seller reputation, item match, condition, return policy, warranty, delivery date, and final checkout total.
steps.expect: the offer is genuinely at or below the target low.

steps.action: **Place the order if all constraints pass.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* payment authorizes on submission; confirm exact item, seller, and total first.
steps.expect: order confirmation number is issued.

steps.action: **Watch for cancellation or price adjustment.** Save the confirmation and monitor shipping status until the order is fulfilled.
steps.expect: the item ships or you recover funds if canceled.

recipes.verification: An order confirmation exists for the exact acceptable item from an acceptable seller, and the final all-in price is at or below the pre-defined target low.

recipes.title: buy during a flash sale
recipes.name: buy-during-a-flash-sale
recipes.goal: You buy a planned item during a short flash sale without overpaying, missing key terms, or buying the wrong product under time pressure.

steps.action: **Prepare the buy rules before the sale starts.** Record exact item, acceptable variants, seller, condition, maximum total, and quantity limit.
steps.expect: a written rule that prevents impulse substitutions.

steps.action: **Log in and verify checkout readiness.** Confirm address, payment method, account security, and any required membership.
steps.expect: checkout can proceed without account setup delays.

steps.action: **Open the sale from a trusted source.** Use the retailer site/app or official sale page, not suspicious ad links.
steps.expect: you are viewing the legitimate sale inventory.

steps.action: **Validate the item under sale pressure.** Confirm model, size, color, warranty, seller, return policy, delivery date, and final price.
steps.expect: the sale offer matches your buy rules.

steps.action: **Apply only fast, compatible discounts.** Use known coupons, store credit, or payment offers that do not risk losing the item or changing terms.
steps.expect: checkout total is as low as practical within the time limit.

steps.action: **Submit the order if it meets the cap.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* flash-sale checkout may charge immediately and sell out fast; confirm item, quantity, total, and return policy before clicking place order.
steps.expect: order confirmation number appears.

steps.action: **Save proof and watch fulfillment.** Capture confirmation, sale price, and estimated delivery; monitor for cancellation or substitution.
steps.expect: order status moves to processing or shipped.

steps.action: **Cancel quickly if you made an error.** Use the store's cancellation window if you bought the wrong item or price exceeded your cap.
steps.expect: cancellation confirmation or a return plan exists.

recipes.verification: An order confirmation exists for the planned item or acceptable variant, from the legitimate seller, with final total at or below the pre-set flash-sale cap.

recipes.title: combine a gift card with a sale
recipes.name: combine-a-gift-card-with-a-sale
recipes.goal: You use a valid gift card during a real sale to reduce out-of-pocket cost without losing protections or getting stuck with unusable balance.

steps.action: **Verify the gift card source.** Use cards purchased directly from the merchant, a reputable retailer, or a trusted rewards program; avoid strangers selling codes.
steps.expect: the card source has low fraud risk and proof of purchase.

steps.action: **Check balance and restrictions.** Confirm balance, expiration rules, regional limits, and whether the card works online, in store, or on sale items.
steps.expect: the gift card is valid for the intended purchase path.

steps.action: **Confirm the sale is real.** Compare current price against recent price history and at least one competitor.
steps.expect: the sale price is meaningfully below the normal market price.

steps.action: **Apply sale discounts first.** Add the item to cart and apply eligible sale codes before gift card redemption.
steps.expect: the cart shows the lowest merchant price before gift-card payment.

steps.action: **Redeem only the needed gift-card value.** If partial redemption is possible, use the amount needed for this order and leave no large stranded balance.
steps.expect: the remaining payment due and residual balance are clear.

steps.action: **Use a protected payment method for any remainder.** Pay the non-gift-card balance with a card that preserves purchase or dispute protections when possible.
steps.expect: the payment split is visible before final submission.

steps.action: **Place the order after confirming return handling.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* gift-card-funded refunds often return to gift-card balance, so confirm item, price, and return policy before paying.
steps.expect: the receipt shows sale discount, gift-card payment, and any remaining charge.

recipes.verification: The order confirmation shows the correct sale price, successful gift-card application, and final out-of-pocket charge at or below your target amount.

recipes.title: compare unit prices
recipes.name: compare-unit-prices
recipes.goal: You compare two or more package sizes by true cost per usable unit, then buy the option that fits your budget, storage, and usage rate.

steps.action: **List the comparable products.** Open each product page or shelf tag and write down brand, package size, quantity, and displayed price.
steps.expect: a side-by-side list of every candidate you may buy.

steps.action: **Normalize the unit.** Convert every quantity to one unit, such as price per ounce, per gram, per sheet, or per dose.
steps.expect: all candidates use the same denominator.

steps.action: **Use the final payable price.** Add required shipping, taxes, bottle deposits, service fees, and subtract real coupons that apply to that exact item.
steps.expect: each candidate has a realistic checkout price, not just a shelf price.

steps.action: **Calculate unit price.** Divide final payable price by usable units, excluding packaging, water weight when irrelevant, or bundled extras you will not use.
steps.expect: every item has a cost per usable unit.

steps.action: **Check quality and concentration.** For concentrates, detergents, batteries, medications, and supplements, compare active ingredients, dose count, or expected performance rather than container size.
steps.expect: the comparison reflects useful output, not misleading package volume.

steps.action: **Reject false bulk savings.** If the larger package expires, spoils, or takes storage you do not have before you can use it, treat the waste as part of the cost.
steps.expect: an adjusted winner that you can actually use.

steps.action: **Buy the best eligible option.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before checkout, confirm the cart total is within your budget and the selected item is the unit-price winner after all fees.
steps.expect: the order or purchase receipt shows the chosen item and final price.

recipes.verification: The purchased item has the lowest final cost per usable unit among eligible options, after required fees and realistic waste, and the receipt total stays within the chosen budget.

recipes.title: find a working promo code
recipes.name: find-a-working-promo-code
recipes.goal: You find and apply a legitimate promo code that lowers the checkout price without adding unwanted subscriptions, fake sites, or invalid terms.

steps.action: **Record the starting checkout total.** Include item price, shipping, tax, fees, and any automatic discounts.
steps.expect: a baseline total you can compare against.

steps.action: **Check first-party sources.** Look at the store banner, email signup offer, loyalty account, app offer, student/military/teacher programs if applicable, and product page.
steps.expect: official codes or offers are identified first.

steps.action: **Search reputable coupon sources.** Use known coupon sites, cashback portals, and recent community posts; avoid sites demanding payment, downloads, or credentials.
steps.expect: a short list of plausible codes with recent success signals.

steps.action: **Test codes one at a time.** Apply a code, read the discount line and exclusions, then remove it before testing the next if stacking is not allowed.
steps.expect: each code is accepted, rejected, or shown to be worse than another.

steps.action: **Watch for cart changes.** Confirm the code did not change seller, shipping speed, subscription status, warranty, or return terms.
steps.expect: the cart still contains exactly what you intended to buy.

steps.action: **Select the best valid code.** Choose the code with the lowest total, not the largest advertised percentage.
steps.expect: checkout shows the lowest verified total for the same cart.

steps.action: **Buy only if the total meets your cap.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* submitting checkout charges your payment method; confirm item, total, code, shipping, and return policy first.
steps.expect: order confirmation appears or you leave without buying.

steps.action: **Save the discount proof.** Keep a screenshot or order summary showing the code and final total.
steps.expect: you have evidence if the discount disappears or order support asks.

recipes.verification: Checkout or order confirmation shows the promo code applied to the intended cart and the final total is below the recorded baseline and at or below your maximum price.

recipes.title: find an open box deal
recipes.name: find-an-open-box-deal
recipes.goal: You buy an open-box item only when its condition, included parts, warranty, return rights, and discount justify the risk versus buying new.

steps.action: **Define the acceptable open-box condition.** Decide which grades, missing accessories, cosmetic flaws, and warranty reductions you will accept.
steps.expect: a written condition threshold.

steps.action: **Compare against new and refurbished prices.** Include current sale prices, coupons, warranty value, and return windows.
steps.expect: the minimum open-box price advantage is clear.

steps.action: **Find open-box inventory from reputable sellers.** Search retailer outlet pages, local store inventory, marketplace warehouse deals, and certified open-box sections.
steps.expect: candidate listings from sellers with return support.

steps.action: **Inspect the listing details closely.** Confirm exact model, condition grade, missing parts, photos if available, warranty, return policy, and whether it is final sale.
steps.expect: the candidate meets your condition threshold or is rejected.

steps.action: **Calculate all-in value.** Add shipping, tax, missing accessory replacement, and warranty gaps.
steps.expect: the open-box deal still beats your minimum discount.

steps.action: **Buy only if return protection is acceptable.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* checkout charges your payment method; confirm condition, seller, accessories, return window, and final total first.
steps.expect: order confirmation or pickup reservation appears.

steps.action: **Inspect immediately on receipt or pickup.** Check serial/model, accessories, damage, activation locks, battery health if relevant, and basic function before the return window shrinks.
steps.expect: the item is accepted or a return is started.

steps.action: **Register warranty and save documents.** Keep receipt, condition grade, photos, and warranty confirmation.
steps.expect: you can prove purchase terms if support is needed.

recipes.verification: The open-box item is ordered or purchased with final total at or below the target open-box price, and post-purchase inspection confirms the exact model, acceptable condition, required accessories, and return/warranty protection.

recipes.title: find the real lowest price
recipes.name: find-the-real-lowest-price
recipes.goal: You identify the true lowest price for an item after model differences, fees, shipping, taxes, rebates, rewards, and return risk.

steps.action: **Define the exact product.** Record model number, size, color, capacity, condition, warranty, and required accessories.
steps.expect: a product spec that prevents comparing different versions.

steps.action: **Collect candidate prices.** Search the merchant, marketplaces, manufacturer, local stores, and reputable price-comparison tools.
steps.expect: at least three candidate sellers or a reason fewer exist.

steps.action: **Calculate delivered cost.** Add shipping, taxes, handling, installation, required memberships, deposits, and subtract automatic discounts only if they apply.
steps.expect: each seller has a comparable final total.

steps.action: **Value rewards conservatively.** Count cashback, points, or rebates only if you will actually receive and use them; discount uncertain rewards.
steps.expect: a net effective price and a cash price for each option.

steps.action: **Check seller and return risk.** Verify seller ratings, authorization status, warranty eligibility, return window, restocking fees, and counterfeit risk.
steps.expect: risky sellers are marked or excluded.

steps.action: **Match delivery and availability.** Confirm in-stock status and arrival date before treating a price as valid.
steps.expect: every remaining option can arrive when needed.

steps.action: **Buy the lowest acceptable option.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before checkout, confirm exact model, seller, final total, and return policy.
steps.expect: the confirmation page shows the chosen seller and total price.

recipes.verification: The purchased item matches the required spec and has the lowest acceptable delivered cost among checked sellers, with order confirmation and final total at or below the preset cap.

recipes.title: get a first order discount
recipes.name: get-a-first-order-discount
recipes.goal: You apply a legitimate first-order discount to a needed purchase while avoiding unwanted subscriptions, inflated prices, and spam.

steps.action: **Start with the needed item.** Add only the item you already planned to buy, not filler added to chase a discount.
steps.expect: the cart contains the intended product and quantity.

steps.action: **Find the official new-customer offer.** Check the merchant homepage, email signup modal, app install offer, or authorized affiliate page.
steps.expect: a stated code, automatic discount, or email offer with terms.

steps.action: **Read the conditions.** Confirm minimum spend, exclusions, expiration, one-time account rules, and whether sale items qualify.
steps.expect: you know exactly what must be true for the discount to apply.

steps.action: **Apply the offer.** Enter the code or follow the linked checkout path, then refresh the cart total.
steps.expect: the discount appears as a line item in the cart.

steps.action: **Compare against alternatives.** Check at least one competitor or marketplace price after shipping and fees.
steps.expect: the discounted cart is still the best or an acceptable choice.

steps.action: **Check marketing and subscription defaults.** Uncheck unwanted email, SMS, auto-ship, or paid-membership options unless you intentionally want them.
steps.expect: only desired services remain selected.

steps.action: **Place the order if the total beats your cap.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm final total, delivery address, return policy, and that the first-order discount remains applied before paying.
steps.expect: the order confirmation shows the discount and final charged amount.

recipes.verification: The order confirmation shows the intended item, a first-order discount line item, and a final charged amount at or below your predefined cap with no unwanted recurring service.

recipes.title: set a max bid and walk away
recipes.name: set-a-max-bid-and-walk-away
recipes.goal: You set a rational maximum bid for an auction and stop bidding once the total cost would exceed it.

steps.action: **Define the value of the item to you.** Use market comps, condition, warranty, urgency, and replacement alternatives.
steps.expect: a maximum all-in value, not just a bid amount.

steps.action: **List every added cost.** Include shipping, tax, buyer premium, payment fee, pickup travel, repair needs, and accessories.
steps.expect: a realistic estimate of non-bid costs.

steps.action: **Convert all-in value into max bid.** Subtract added costs from the all-in cap and round down if uncertain.
steps.expect: one hard maximum bid number.

steps.action: **Write the walk-away rule before bidding.** State that any required bid above the maximum means you lose intentionally.
steps.expect: the rule is visible before auction pressure starts.

steps.action: **Enter only the maximum you mean.** [BRANCH: proxy bid | manual bid] Use the platform's max-bid feature or stop manual bidding at the threshold. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* bids may be binding; confirm amount and currency before submitting.
steps.expect: your bid exposure cannot exceed your written max.

steps.action: **Do not revise upward during the auction.** Treat being outbid as useful information, not a failure.
steps.expect: you either remain highest under cap or walk away.

steps.action: **Close the loop after the auction.** If you win, verify invoice total; if you lose, remove alerts or keep watching only if the same cap still applies.
steps.expect: no post-auction regret purchase above cap occurs.

recipes.verification: Your highest submitted bid is at or below the pre-calculated maximum bid, and the final invoice if you win is at or below the all-in cap.

recipes.title: set a price drop alert
recipes.name: set-a-price-drop-alert
recipes.goal: You create a reliable alert that notifies you only when a specific item reaches a price you would actually pay.

steps.action: **Identify the exact item to track.** Use model number, size, color, storage, bundle contents, and seller type to avoid variant confusion.
steps.expect: the tracked item matches what you would buy.

steps.action: **Set the target threshold.** Choose an all-in or item-price threshold and note whether tax, shipping, or coupons are included.
steps.expect: the alert price reflects your real decision point.

steps.action: **Choose a tracker source.** [BRANCH: retailer wishlist | third-party price tracker | deal forum alert] Pick a tool that supports the store and item.
steps.expect: the tracker can monitor the page or keyword.

steps.action: **Create the alert with filters.** Enter URL or keywords, target price, condition, seller, and notification channel.
steps.expect: the alert is saved and enabled.

steps.action: **Test or confirm notifications.** Send a test notification if available or check that email/app/browser permissions are enabled.
steps.expect: alerts can reach you promptly.

steps.action: **Record buy rules next to the alert.** Include maximum total, acceptable sellers, warranty requirements, and expiration date for the alert.
steps.expect: future you can decide quickly without rethinking the whole purchase.

steps.action: **Act only after validating an alert.** When notified, open the store directly from a trusted source and confirm final price and item match.
steps.expect: the alert leads to a real, valid offer or is ignored.

recipes.verification: The tracker shows an enabled alert for the exact item or keyword rule, with a defined target price and a working notification channel.

recipes.title: snipe a limited drop
recipes.name: snipe-a-limited-drop
recipes.goal: You attempt to buy a limited-release item at retail or below your cap using legitimate checkout methods, while avoiding botting, scams, and panic buying.

steps.action: **Define the target and fallback order.** Rank acceptable variants and sizes, set maximum total, and decide whether no purchase is better than a bad variant.
steps.expect: a clear priority list and walk-away rule.

steps.action: **Verify the official drop channel.** Confirm the retailer URL/app, timezone, queue rules, raffle rules, and account requirements from first-party sources.
steps.expect: you know where and when to attempt checkout.

steps.action: **Prepare legitimate checkout.** Log in, verify 2FA, save address/payment, update app, and test that your account is not locked.
steps.expect: checkout prerequisites are ready before the drop.

steps.action: **Join only allowed queues or raffles.** Do not use bots, fake identities, or prohibited account farms.
steps.expect: your entry or queue position follows seller rules.

steps.action: **At drop time, select the highest-ranked available variant.** Move quickly but confirm item identity, size/color, seller, and price.
steps.expect: cart contains an acceptable target variant.

steps.action: **Submit if the final total meets the cap.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* limited-drop checkout can charge instantly and may be hard to cancel; confirm item, variant, quantity, total, and return rules first.
steps.expect: order confirmation, raffle entry confirmation, or sold-out message appears.

steps.action: **Record the result.** Save confirmation number, entry ID, or sold-out evidence and do not keep retrying through suspicious links.
steps.expect: you know whether you purchased, entered, or failed.

steps.action: **Monitor fraud and fulfillment.** Watch for cancellation, payment verification, shipping, and fake resale offers.
steps.expect: legitimate order progresses or funds are released if canceled.

recipes.verification: The official retailer shows an order confirmation or raffle entry for an acceptable variant at or below the maximum total, or the attempt ends with no purchase because the rules were not met.

recipes.title: spot a fake discount
recipes.name: spot-a-fake-discount
recipes.goal: You determine whether a promoted discount is genuine, then buy only if the final price is actually competitive.

steps.action: **Capture the advertised claim.** Note the sale price, claimed original price, percent off, code, deadline, and seller.
steps.expect: the discount claim is documented.

steps.action: **Verify the exact product.** Check model number, size, condition, generation, warranty, and included accessories.
steps.expect: the sale item is not a downgraded variant.

steps.action: **Check price history.** Use price trackers, archived pages, previous receipts, or retailer history to see recent normal prices.
steps.expect: you know whether the reference price was recently real.

steps.action: **Compare live competitors.** Search the exact item at reputable sellers and include shipping, taxes, and required fees.
steps.expect: a market price range for the same item.

steps.action: **Look for pressure tactics.** Treat countdown timers, inflated "was" prices, and limited stock claims as unproven until price data supports them.
steps.expect: urgency does not override the price evidence.

steps.action: **Decide based on final value.** Buy only if the final delivered cost is below your cap and competitive with real market pricing. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm the discount remains applied at checkout before paying.
steps.expect: either a confirmed order at a genuine deal price or no purchase.

recipes.verification: The final decision is backed by documented market comparison: either the order total is below the preset cap and below comparable market prices, or the fake discount is rejected with no payment made.

recipes.title: stack coupons and cashback
recipes.name: stack-coupons-and-cashback
recipes.goal: You combine eligible store coupons, promo codes, cashback portals, loyalty rewards, and payment offers to buy an intended item at the lowest confirmed net price.

steps.action: **Define the exact target and price cap.** Record item, model, color/size flexibility, shipping need, tax estimate, and maximum net price after rewards you trust.
steps.expect: a clear buy/no-buy threshold.

steps.action: **Find the base price from reputable sellers.** Compare the same item across stores, including shipping and pickup options.
steps.expect: the current best base price is known.

steps.action: **Check coupon eligibility before activating cashback.** Read exclusions, minimum spend, one-use limits, and whether codes invalidate cashback.
steps.expect: only compatible coupon candidates remain.

steps.action: **Choose the cashback path.** Pick the highest reliable portal or card offer that applies to the store and category, noting payout rate and exclusions.
steps.expect: one cashback route is selected with a documented expected value.

steps.action: **Start a clean shopping session.** Disable conflicting extensions if needed, click through the chosen cashback portal, and add only the target item to cart.
steps.expect: the store opens from the portal and the cart contains the intended item.

steps.action: **Apply coupons in a controlled order.** Test codes, store rewards, gift cards, and payment offers without changing the item or seller.
steps.expect: checkout shows the lowest valid out-the-door price.

steps.action: **Calculate net price conservatively.** Count instant discounts fully, but count cashback only if it tracks and is not excluded.
steps.expect: the net price is at or below your cap, or the purchase is rejected.

steps.action: **Place the order only if the stack is valid.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* payment authorizes when you submit; confirm item, seller, shipping, tax, discounts, and return policy first.
steps.expect: an order confirmation number appears.

steps.action: **Verify cashback and save evidence.** Screenshot order summary, note portal click ID if available, and check tracking after the portal's expected delay.
steps.expect: cashback is tracked or you have the documents needed for a claim.

recipes.verification: The final order has a confirmation number, the charged checkout total plus only reliable tracked rewards is at or below the pre-set maximum net price, and cashback or offer tracking evidence is saved.

recipes.title: time a seasonal purchase
recipes.name: time-a-seasonal-purchase
recipes.goal: You decide whether to buy now or wait for a predictable seasonal discount, while avoiding stockouts and urgency traps.

steps.action: **Define the purchase deadline.** Write the date by which the item must be in your hands, including shipping time.
steps.expect: a latest safe order date.

steps.action: **Set a walk-away price.** Decide the maximum total price you will pay after tax, shipping, warranties, and fees.
steps.expect: a hard price cap for comparison.

steps.action: **Check historical sale timing.** Look at price trackers, past retailer ads, category sale calendars, and major holidays for the item type.
steps.expect: a likely discount window and typical discount depth.

steps.action: **Monitor current availability.** Check stock levels, colors, sizes, and shipping estimates at several sellers.
steps.expect: a view of whether waiting risks losing the needed configuration.

steps.action: **Set price alerts.** Create alerts for the exact model and acceptable substitutes at or below your price cap.
steps.expect: alerts are active and tied to specific target prices.

steps.action: **Decide buy now or wait.** [BRANCH: need soon or inventory is thin, buy if current total is at or below cap | flexible timing and discounts likely, wait until the sale window or alert]
steps.expect: a dated decision with a trigger for action.

steps.action: **Checkout only when conditions are met.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before placing the order, confirm final total, arrival date, return policy, and that the item matches the target model.
steps.expect: either a confirmed order under the cap or no purchase yet.

recipes.verification: Success is either an order confirmation for the correct item with final total at or below the stated cap and arriving by the deadline, or a documented decision to wait with active alerts and no payment made.

recipes.title: use a cashback portal
recipes.name: use-a-cashback-portal
recipes.goal: You route an eligible purchase through a cashback portal so the order tracks and the expected reward can be verified later.

steps.action: **Confirm the portal and payout setup.** Log in, verify your email if required, and check that payout method and minimum payout threshold are acceptable.
steps.expect: the account can receive cashback if the purchase tracks.

steps.action: **Read the store-specific cashback terms.** Check eligible categories, coupon restrictions, gift card rules, subscription exclusions, and rate caps.
steps.expect: you know whether the intended purchase qualifies.

steps.action: **Prepare a clean cart path.** Close old store tabs, disable competing cashback extensions if necessary, and avoid using unlisted coupons.
steps.expect: nothing obvious will overwrite the portal tracking.

steps.action: **Click from the portal to the store.** Use the portal's shopping button and wait for the store page to load from that click.
steps.expect: the portal records a click or shopping trip.

steps.action: **Complete the purchase in the same session.** Add the eligible item, keep the same browser tab if possible, and avoid navigating through another deal site. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* checkout charges your payment method; confirm item, total, eligibility, and return policy before placing order.
steps.expect: the store issues an order confirmation number.

steps.action: **Save confirmation evidence.** Record order number, subtotal, date/time, portal click ID if shown, and cashback rate.
steps.expect: you have the details needed for a missing-cashback claim.

steps.action: **Check tracking after the normal delay.** Look for pending cashback in the portal account, not just browser notifications.
steps.expect: the purchase appears as pending cashback or you know it is missing.

steps.action: **Follow through until payable.** Avoid canceling, returning, or modifying the order unless necessary, and monitor pending-to-approved status.
steps.expect: cashback becomes payable or a claim is filed with evidence.

recipes.verification: The store order is confirmed, the cashback portal shows the purchase as pending or approved for the expected eligible amount, and order/click evidence is saved until payout.

recipes.title: use a loyalty app for discounts
recipes.name: use-a-loyalty-app-for-discounts
recipes.goal: You use a store loyalty app to apply eligible discounts at checkout without accidentally accepting unwanted tracking, subscriptions, or higher total cost.

steps.action: **Confirm the app is official.** Install or open the app from the store's website, app-store publisher page, or known account portal.
steps.expect: the app name, publisher, and login domain match the retailer.

steps.action: **Sign in or create the minimum account needed.** Use only required identity fields and skip optional profile data when possible.
steps.expect: the loyalty account opens without unnecessary personal details added.

steps.action: **Review privacy and notification prompts.** Allow only permissions needed for discounts, such as barcode display or location for nearby store offers if you accept that tradeoff.
steps.expect: the app works while exposing no more data than you chose.

steps.action: **Clip or activate relevant offers.** Search for the exact items, store location, and pickup or delivery mode; clip manufacturer and store coupons before checkout.
steps.expect: activated offers appear in a saved or clipped list.

steps.action: **Check offer rules.** Read size, quantity, brand, expiration, member tier, delivery method, and stacking limits.
steps.expect: each discount is tied to an item you will actually buy under valid conditions.

steps.action: **Scan or attach the loyalty account at checkout.** [BRANCH: in-store, scan the loyalty barcode or enter phone number before payment | online, confirm the loyalty account is attached to the cart]
steps.expect: the checkout screen recognizes the loyalty account.

steps.action: **Verify discounts before paying.** Compare the expected discount list to the checkout total. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* do not pay until missing discounts are corrected or you accept the final total.
steps.expect: the receipt preview shows the intended discounts and total.

steps.action: **Save the receipt and offer proof.** Keep the digital receipt and screenshots of large clipped offers until returns or rebates clear.
steps.expect: you have proof if a discount fails or rebate is denied.

recipes.verification: The checkout receipt shows the loyalty account applied, all intended eligible discounts are deducted, and the final paid total is lower than the same basket without the app.

recipes.title: use a rewards marketplace
recipes.name: use-a-rewards-marketplace
recipes.goal: You route a planned purchase through a legitimate rewards marketplace or shopping portal so eligible rewards track and post without increasing the price.

steps.action: **Confirm merchant eligibility.** Search the rewards marketplace for the exact merchant and read excluded categories, coupon restrictions, and payout terms.
steps.expect: you know the reward rate and exclusions.

steps.action: **Compare reward portals.** Check at least two portals or card-linked offers and note payout currency, timing, and reliability.
steps.expect: the best reliable reward option is selected.

steps.action: **Prepare a clean session.** Empty old carts if needed, disable conflicting coupon extensions, and sign into the portal and merchant.
steps.expect: tracking blockers are minimized.

steps.action: **Click through from the portal.** Use the portal's shopping link and go directly to the merchant without opening competing affiliate links.
steps.expect: the portal displays an activated shopping trip.

steps.action: **Build the cart after activation.** Add the intended item, apply only allowed coupons, and avoid excluded payment methods if the terms mention them.
steps.expect: the merchant cart remains eligible for rewards.

steps.action: **Place the order only if the price still wins.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before paying, confirm final merchant total is not higher than buying directly or elsewhere.
steps.expect: order confirmation is complete and the portal trip can be matched to it.

steps.action: **Save proof and track posting.** Keep the order number, subtotal, portal click time, and screenshots until rewards move from pending to payable.
steps.expect: pending rewards appear or you have evidence for a claim.

recipes.verification: The purchase is confirmed at the same or lower cash price than buying directly, and the rewards marketplace shows a tracked trip or pending reward tied to the order number.

recipes.title: use a student discount
recipes.name: use-a-student-discount
recipes.goal: You verify legitimate student eligibility and apply the discount to a purchase or subscription without exposing more personal data than necessary.

steps.action: **Confirm the discount source.** Start from the merchant's official student-discount page or a known verification provider linked from it.
steps.expect: the offer is hosted by the merchant or an authorized verifier.

steps.action: **Read eligibility and renewal terms.** Check school type, country, graduation-date, subscription-renewal, and proof requirements.
steps.expect: you know whether you qualify and when the discount expires.

steps.action: **Verify with minimal data.** Use school email or portal login when possible; upload ID only if required and redact nonessential information if allowed.
steps.expect: the verifier confirms student status or requests a specific correction.

steps.action: **Apply the discount to the intended item.** Add the product or plan to cart through the verified link or enter the issued code.
steps.expect: the cart shows the student price on the correct item.

steps.action: **Check exclusions and stacking.** Confirm whether the discount works with sale prices, bundles, gift cards, or cashback portals.
steps.expect: the best permitted combination is selected.

steps.action: **Complete checkout only if the final price is acceptable.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before paying, confirm final total, renewal price, billing date, and account receiving the benefit.
steps.expect: an order or subscription confirmation shows the student discount applied.

steps.action: **Save renewal reminders.** Add the next verification or renewal date to your calendar if the discount is on a recurring plan.
steps.expect: you have a reminder before full-price billing begins.

recipes.verification: The merchant receipt or account billing page shows the correct student-discounted price, the renewal date is known, and the final amount paid is at or below your price cap.

recipes.title: wait for a better price
recipes.name: wait-for-a-better-price
recipes.goal: You decide not to buy yet, define the better price you are waiting for, and set a follow-up system so the purchase happens only if the deal improves enough.

steps.action: **Confirm the purchase can wait.** Check whether delaying creates real costs, missed deadlines, expiring need, or stock risk.
steps.expect: waiting is acceptable or the purchase is reclassified as urgent.

steps.action: **Record the current total price.** Include shipping, tax, fees, required accessories, and available discounts.
steps.expect: today's real price is documented.

steps.action: **Set the better-price target.** Choose a target based on historical lows, sale cycles, alternatives, and how much delay is worth.
steps.expect: a specific buy price and latest buy date.

steps.action: **Define acceptable alternatives.** List substitute models, colors, sellers, used/refurbished options, or rental/borrowing options.
steps.expect: future deals can be judged without scope creep.

steps.action: **Set alerts and review dates.** Use price trackers, wishlists, deal alerts, and a calendar check before the latest buy date.
steps.expect: you have automated or scheduled reminders.

steps.action: **Avoid cart-pressure tactics.** Ignore countdown timers, low-stock warnings, and retargeting ads unless the final price meets your rule.
steps.expect: no purchase happens from pressure alone.

steps.action: **Re-evaluate when alerted or at review.** Confirm item match, seller, total price, and whether your need has changed.
steps.expect: the decision is buy, keep waiting, change target, or abandon.

steps.action: **Buy only when the rule is met.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* payment authorizes at checkout; confirm the target price and constraints before ordering.
steps.expect: either an order confirmation under the target or a documented decision not to buy.

recipes.verification: There is either no purchase and an active alert/review plan with a target price and deadline, or an order confirmation for an acceptable item at or below the better-price target.

recipes.title: dispute a marketplace purchase
recipes.name: dispute-a-marketplace-purchase
recipes.goal: Dispute a marketplace order that was not received, not as described, counterfeit, damaged, or incorrectly refunded.

steps.action: **Read the marketplace policy.** Find deadlines for item-not-received, not-as-described, counterfeit, damaged, return, and appeal claims.
steps.expect: the correct claim type and deadline are known.

steps.action: **Collect evidence.** Save listing screenshots, photos, tracking, delivery photo, packaging, serial numbers, messages, and payment record.
steps.expect: the evidence supports your specific issue.
