steps.action: **Contact the seller in-platform.** Explain the problem, requested remedy, and evidence without moving to email or text.
steps.expect: the seller response is recorded by the marketplace.

steps.action: **Wait only the required period.** Give the seller the platform's stated response time, not an indefinite extension.
steps.expect: you know when escalation is allowed.

steps.action: **Open the marketplace dispute.** [BRANCH: item not received | not as described | damaged | counterfeit | refund issue] select the accurate reason and upload evidence.
steps.expect: the case number and deadline appear.

steps.action: **Follow return instructions exactly.** If return is required, use the provided label, photograph the packed item, and keep drop-off receipt. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* once shipped back, you lose possession, so document condition and tracking first.
steps.expect: tracking proves return handoff.

steps.action: **Respond to case messages.** Upload requested evidence before each deadline and keep communication in-platform.
steps.expect: the case remains active.

steps.action: **Escalate or appeal if needed.** If seller refuses or the decision ignores evidence, use marketplace appeal before deadline.
steps.expect: a reviewer receives the full record.

steps.action: **Consider payment dispute last.** If marketplace process fails, compare card or payment-service dispute deadlines and risks. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* chargebacks can affect marketplace account standing, so use them only with saved evidence.
steps.expect: you choose escalation knowingly.

recipes.verification: The marketplace case shows refund, replacement, return acceptance, or written final decision, and your payment account reflects any approved refund.

recipes.title: file a warranty claim
recipes.name: file-a-warranty-claim
recipes.goal: Submit a warranty claim with the documents and evidence needed for repair, replacement, refund, or denial review.

steps.action: **Find the warranty terms.** Read coverage period, covered defects, exclusions, required maintenance, shipping duties, and claim channel.
steps.expect: you know whether the issue may be covered.

steps.action: **Confirm purchase proof.** Locate receipt, invoice, order confirmation, gift receipt, card statement, or warranty registration.
steps.expect: purchase date and seller are documented.

steps.action: **Document the defect.** Photograph or record the issue, error codes, serial number label, and product condition.
steps.expect: evidence shows both defect and product identity.

steps.action: **Try required troubleshooting.** Follow only safe manufacturer steps such as reset, cleaning, firmware update, or diagnostic test.
steps.expect: you can report what did and did not work.

steps.action: **Submit the claim.** [BRANCH: online form | phone | retailer | manufacturer] provide model, serial, purchase date, seller, defect, and evidence.
steps.expect: you receive a claim number or support ticket.

steps.action: **Review shipping or service terms.** Check who pays shipping, whether packaging is required, whether a hold is placed on your card, and expected timeline.
steps.expect: costs and responsibilities are clear.

steps.action: **Send the item only when authorized.** Use the provided label, packing instructions, and tracking. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* once shipped for warranty service, you may lose possession for weeks, so confirm claim number and tracking first.
steps.expect: tracking or service appointment confirms handoff.

steps.action: **Track the outcome.** Watch for repair estimate, replacement approval, refund, denial, or request for more information.
steps.expect: the claim status is current.

steps.action: **Verify the remedy.** Test repaired or replacement item and save final paperwork.
steps.expect: the defect is fixed or the denial reason is documented.

recipes.verification: You have a claim number and final written outcome showing repair, replacement, refund, or denial, with proof of shipping or service if applicable.

recipes.title: get a price adjustment after a sale
recipes.name: get-a-price-adjustment-after-a-sale
recipes.goal: Request a refund of the price difference when an item you bought drops in price within the retailer's adjustment window.

steps.action: **Find the policy.** Search the retailer's official price adjustment or price protection terms.
steps.expect: you know the eligible window, exclusions, and channel.

steps.action: **Confirm the exact item.** Compare SKU, model, size, color, quantity, condition, and seller.
steps.expect: the sale item is identical to what you bought.

steps.action: **Check timing.** Count from purchase date or delivery date according to policy.
steps.expect: the request is inside or outside the allowed window.

steps.action: **Capture proof.** Save the lower price page, ad, or shelf label with date and item details visible.
steps.expect: proof is available if the price changes again.

steps.action: **Choose contact channel.** [BRANCH: online order | store receipt] use chat, order support, phone, or service desk as the policy directs.
steps.expect: you are contacting the team that can adjust the price.

steps.action: **Request the adjustment.** Provide order number, item, purchase price, current lower price, and proof.
steps.expect: the agent can calculate the difference.

steps.action: **Review exclusions and amount.** Check whether clearance, coupon, membership price, third-party seller, bundle, tax, shipping, or price-match rules limit the refund.
steps.expect: approval or denial reason is specific.

steps.action: **Accept the credit.** Confirm refund amount and destination before the agent submits it. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* accepting a store-credit adjustment may prevent a cash refund later, so confirm refund method first.
steps.expect: confirmation shows the adjustment amount and timing.

steps.action: **Watch the payment method.** Check account activity after the stated processing period.
steps.expect: the credit posts or you have a case number for follow-up.

recipes.verification: The order, receipt, or payment account shows a posted credit for the approved price difference or a written denial explaining the policy reason.

recipes.title: accept payment safely in person
recipes.name: accept-payment-safely-in-person
recipes.goal: You accept in-person payment for a marketplace sale only after confirming the funds are real, final enough for the item value, and matched to the buyer and item.

steps.action: **Set payment terms before the meetup.** Tell the buyer which methods you accept, whether exact cash is required, and that the item is released only after you verify payment.
steps.expect: the buyer knows the payment rule before traveling.

steps.action: **Choose a safe verification setup.** Meet where you have signal, lighting, cameras, and enough time to open your own app or count cash.
steps.expect: you can verify funds without pressure or poor connectivity.

steps.action: **Inspect the buyer's payment attempt calmly.** [BRANCH: cash | instant payment app | platform in-person checkout] Watch for the agreed amount, correct recipient, and no unusual refund or overpayment story.
steps.expect: the attempted payment matches the sale terms.

steps.action: **Verify in your own account.** Count cash yourself or open your own app from your phone; never rely on the buyer's screenshot, email, or sound notification.
steps.expect: your account or hand-counted cash shows the full agreed amount.

steps.action: **Handle overpayment or third-party payment as a stop sign.** Decline any request to refund extra money, accept a "business account upgrade" fee, or release the item before funds clear.
steps.expect: suspicious payment patterns end the transaction instead of continuing.

steps.action: **Give a simple receipt for higher-value sales.** Include date, item, serial number if relevant, amount paid, payment method, and "sold as described" where lawful.
steps.expect: both parties have a basic record of what changed hands.

steps.action: **Release the item only after confirmation.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* once the buyer leaves, recovery is unlikely; confirm the money first, then hand over the item.
steps.expect: item handoff occurs after verified payment.

steps.action: **Record and secure proceeds.** Move cash out of public view or leave the meetup area before reorganizing money; screenshot your own settled receipt if useful.
steps.expect: proceeds are secured and the listing can be marked sold.

recipes.verification: The full agreed payment is confirmed by cash in hand or by your own account showing the incoming payment, and the item is released only after that confirmation.

recipes.title: avoid a scam as a seller
recipes.name: avoid-a-scam-as-a-seller
recipes.goal: You recognize and stop common marketplace seller scams before releasing goods, account access, money, or personal information.

steps.action: **Keep the conversation in the marketplace.** Reply through the platform unless the platform itself provides a protected checkout or pickup workflow.
steps.expect: there is a traceable record.

steps.action: **Check for scam signals.** Watch for overpayment, courier pickup, urgent scripts, bad grammar patterns, verification-code requests, external links, and payment screenshots.
steps.expect: suspicious buyers are identified before commitment.

steps.action: **Verify payment only in your own account.** Open the payment app or marketplace order directly; do not trust emails, screenshots, or buyer confirmations.
steps.expect: payment status is independently confirmed or not present.

steps.action: **Refuse security-code requests.** Never share one-time passcodes, login links, or account recovery codes.
steps.expect: your marketplace, email, and payment accounts remain protected.

steps.action: **Use safe address rules.** Ship only to the platform-provided address and meet locally only in a public safe place when possible.
steps.expect: the buyer cannot redirect goods outside protection.

steps.action: **Apply a release checklist.** Confirm buyer identity only as needed, final price, cleared payment, correct item, and safe handoff or tracked shipping.
steps.expect: all release conditions are satisfied.

steps.action: **Release the item only after confirmation.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* once handed over or shipped, recovery is uncertain; confirm payment and terms first.
steps.expect: the item leaves your control only under protected conditions.

steps.action: **Report and block suspicious buyers.** Use platform reporting tools and save evidence.
steps.expect: the scam attempt is documented and contact stops.

recipes.verification: No goods, money, account codes, or private details have been released to a suspicious buyer, and any completed sale has independently verified payment plus protected handoff or tracked shipment.

recipes.title: bundle items for a better deal
recipes.name: bundle-items-for-a-better-deal
recipes.goal: You combine related marketplace items into a bundle that increases buyer value, reduces shipping or meetup friction, and improves your total net proceeds.

steps.action: **Group compatible items.** Choose items that serve the same buyer, fit together, or make shipping/pickup more efficient.
steps.expect: each bundle has a clear reason to exist.

steps.action: **Price items individually first.** Estimate sold value, fees, and shipping for each item on its own.
steps.expect: you know the unbundled baseline.

steps.action: **Calculate bundle economics.** Add combined shipping, packaging, platform fees, and discount needed to motivate a buyer.
steps.expect: a bundle price that beats separate sales without going below your total floor.

steps.action: **Photograph the set.** Show everything together plus individual condition and flaws for each item.
steps.expect: buyers can verify all included pieces.

steps.action: **Write the bundle listing.** List every included item, condition, sizes/models, missing pieces, and whether you will split the bundle.
steps.expect: the listing prevents confusion about contents.

steps.action: **Set bundle terms.** Decide price, pickup/shipping, whether offers are allowed, and minimum accepted if buyer asks to remove items.
steps.expect: negotiation boundaries are defined.

steps.action: **Publish or send a bundle offer.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm included items and total price before making the offer live.
steps.expect: the buyer sees a single clear bundle deal.

steps.action: **Pack or hand over as one deal.** Confirm every item is included and payment covers the full bundle before release.
steps.expect: the buyer receives the complete set and you receive agreed payment.

steps.action: **Update inventory.** Mark all bundled items sold or remove individual listings to avoid double-selling.
steps.expect: no unavailable item remains active.

recipes.verification: The bundle listing or offer clearly states included items and total terms, expected net proceeds exceed your bundle floor, and all included items are marked sold or removed after payment.

recipes.title: cross post a listing to multiple apps
recipes.name: cross-post-a-listing-to-multiple-apps
recipes.goal: You publish the same item on multiple marketplace apps with consistent details, controlled inventory, and a plan to avoid double-selling.

steps.action: **Create a master listing record.** Write the final title, description, condition, included accessories, flaws, price, pickup or shipping terms, and SKU or nickname.
steps.expect: one source of truth you can paste into each marketplace.

steps.action: **Choose compatible platforms.** Confirm each app allows the item, supports your fulfillment method, and has acceptable fees.
steps.expect: a short list of marketplaces where the item can be sold legally and profitably.

steps.action: **Normalize photos before uploading.** Use the same honest photo set, including flaws and scale references, unless a platform requires different dimensions.
steps.expect: each platform receives clear photos that match the master listing.

steps.action: **Publish the first listing.** Enter the master details, set the price, shipping or meetup terms, and platform-specific return policy. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* publishing exposes the offer publicly; confirm no personal data appears in photos or text.
steps.expect: the first listing is live or submitted for review.

steps.action: **Publish to the remaining apps with platform-specific adjustments.** Keep factual details identical while adapting categories, tags, shipping labels, and fee-aware prices.
steps.expect: every selected marketplace has a live or pending listing for the same item.

steps.action: **Track every listing URL and status.** Record platform, listing ID, listed price, fees, messages link, and whether offers are enabled.
steps.expect: you can find and update every copy quickly.

steps.action: **Respond from the tracker, not memory.** When messages arrive, record serious offers and mark the listing as under negotiation if a buyer is close to paying.
steps.expect: only one buyer at a time is treated as likely to receive the item.

steps.action: **Close all other listings when one buyer commits.** [BRANCH: paid order | local sale scheduled] Mark other platforms paused, pending, or unavailable before handoff if the platform allows it.
steps.expect: competing buyers can no longer purchase unexpectedly.

steps.action: **Remove or mark sold everywhere after payment clears.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* once the item ships or is handed over, confirm payment first, then close every listing.
steps.expect: all copies are sold, ended, deleted, or unavailable.

recipes.verification: Each selected marketplace has either a live/pending listing recorded in the tracker, or after sale, every listing ID in the tracker is marked sold, ended, deleted, or unavailable with the final buyer and confirmed payment recorded.

recipes.title: flip a thrift store find
recipes.name: flip-a-thrift-store-find
recipes.goal: You evaluate, buy, prepare, and resell a thrift-store item only when the expected resale profit justifies the cost, effort, and risk.

steps.action: **Scan only categories you understand.** Focus on brands, materials, electronics, books, home goods, or clothing where you can judge demand and defects.
steps.expect: you avoid random speculative purchases.

steps.action: **Identify a candidate item.** Record brand, model, size, material, condition, completeness, and price tag.
steps.expect: enough information exists to research resale value.

steps.action: **Check sold comps in the store.** Search recent sold listings for the exact or closest item and condition.
steps.expect: a realistic resale range.

steps.action: **Estimate all costs.** Include thrift price, cleaning, repairs, batteries, packaging, shipping, platform fees, returns, and your time.
steps.expect: a maximum buy price and expected profit.

steps.action: **Inspect condition hard.** Check stains, cracks, missing pieces, battery corrosion, odors, authenticity, and whether electronics power on if allowed.
steps.expect: hidden costs are found before purchase.

steps.action: **Decide buy or pass.** Buy only if expected net profit exceeds your target and the item can be listed honestly. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm condition and max buy price before checkout because returns may be limited.
steps.expect: you either buy a qualified item or leave it.

steps.action: **Clean and test after purchase.** Remove dust, launder if appropriate, test functions, and gather included parts.
steps.expect: the item is ready for accurate photos.

steps.action: **List with thrift-specific disclosure.** Photograph condition, disclose flaws, set a competitive price, and avoid unsupported authenticity claims.
steps.expect: the listing is live with profit target preserved.

steps.action: **Ship or hand off after payment.** Use safe marketplace payment and tracked shipping or public meetup.
steps.expect: the sale is completed with evidence.

steps.action: **Calculate actual profit.** Subtract every cost from payout.
steps.expect: you know whether the flip met the target.

recipes.verification: The thrift item was purchased at or below the calculated maximum buy price, listed accurately, sold with verified payment, and produced actual net profit at or above your target.

recipes.title: handle a lowball offer
recipes.name: handle-a-lowball-offer
recipes.goal: You respond to a lowball marketplace offer without wasting time, dropping below your floor, or escalating into an unsafe or unproductive negotiation.

steps.action: **Pause before replying.** Compare the offer against your minimum net, fees, shipping, and urgency.
steps.expect: you know whether the offer is unacceptable, possible, or acceptable.

steps.action: **Classify the offer.** Decide if it is a serious opening offer, a bulk/bundle opportunity, or a time-waster.
steps.expect: your response effort matches buyer quality.

steps.action: **Send a concise counter or decline.** Use one clear price, such as "I can do X if picked up today" or "No thanks, price is firm."
steps.expect: the buyer has a concrete next step.

steps.action: **Avoid defending the price at length.** Point to condition, comps, included extras, or pickup convenience once if needed.
steps.expect: the conversation stays focused.

steps.action: **Set a deadline for special terms.** If you offer a discount for fast pickup or bundle, make the deadline explicit.
steps.expect: the buyer cannot keep a discounted offer open indefinitely.

steps.action: **Stop if pressure continues.** Do not keep negotiating with insults, guilt, or repeated below-floor offers.
steps.expect: your time and price floor are protected.

steps.action: **Accept only if terms are safe.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before accepting, confirm payment method, handoff/shipping, and net proceeds remain above your floor.
steps.expect: any accepted low offer is still a safe deal.

recipes.verification: The lowball offer is declined, countered, or accepted in writing, and any accepted deal preserves your minimum net proceeds and safe payment/handoff terms.

recipes.title: list an item with good photos
recipes.name: list-an-item-with-good-photos
recipes.goal: You produce marketplace photos that accurately show an item's value, condition, size, and defects so the listing gets serious buyers and fewer disputes.

steps.action: **Clean and stage the item.** Remove dust, personal items, clutter, and unrelated objects from the frame.
steps.expect: the item looks presentable without hiding condition.

steps.action: **Choose honest lighting.** Use bright indirect daylight or neutral indoor light; avoid filters that change color.
steps.expect: photos show the true color and surface condition.

steps.action: **Capture the required angles.** Photograph front, back, sides, top/bottom, labels, ports, accessories, and packaging.
steps.expect: a buyer can inspect the full item remotely.

steps.action: **Show scale and fit.** Include measurements, a ruler, model number, size tag, or context object when relevant.
steps.expect: the buyer can judge dimensions or compatibility.

steps.action: **Document every flaw.** Photograph scratches, dents, stains, missing parts, repairs, or wear close-up and in context.
steps.expect: defects are visible before a buyer commits.

steps.action: **Check sharpness and crop.** Retake blurry, dark, overexposed, or cut-off images.
steps.expect: all photos are clear on a phone screen and desktop view.

steps.action: **Remove private information.** Hide addresses, license plates, barcodes tied to accounts, faces, documents, and reflections.
steps.expect: photos disclose the item, not personal data.

steps.action: **Upload photos in buyer-priority order.** Put the strongest full-item image first, then condition, details, flaws, and included extras.
steps.expect: the listing gallery tells a complete condition story.

steps.action: **Publish with matching text.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before making the listing live, confirm the description mentions the flaws shown in photos.
steps.expect: photos and written condition agree.

recipes.verification: The listing has a complete photo gallery showing the whole item, included accessories, measurements or scale where needed, and all material flaws, with no private information visible.

recipes.title: meet a buyer safely
recipes.name: meet-a-buyer-safely
recipes.goal: You arrange and complete an in-person marketplace handoff in a public, controlled way that protects your safety, privacy, item, and payment.

steps.action: **Screen the buyer before scheduling.** Look for normal account history, specific questions, and agreement on price and payment method.
steps.expect: the buyer appears legitimate enough to meet.

steps.action: **Pick a public safe-exchange location.** Prefer a police-station exchange zone, bank lobby, busy store entrance, or camera-covered public place during daylight.
steps.expect: the meeting location is public, well-lit, and easy to leave.

steps.action: **Share a limited plan with the buyer.** Confirm location, time, item, price, and payment method; do not share your home address unless unavoidable for large items.
steps.expect: both parties have the same meetup details.

steps.action: **Tell a trusted person where you are going.** Share buyer name/profile, location, time, and expected return.
steps.expect: someone else knows the handoff plan.

steps.action: **Prepare the item for quick inspection.** Bring only the item being sold, remove personal data, and keep expensive accessories controlled until payment.
steps.expect: inspection can happen without exposing unrelated belongings.

steps.action: **Meet in the public area and keep boundaries.** Stay outside private vehicles and decline last-minute location changes to isolated places.
steps.expect: the buyer inspects the item in the agreed safe location.

steps.action: **Confirm payment before handoff.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* once the buyer leaves with the item, recovery is unlikely; count cash or verify payment in your own app first.
steps.expect: payment is confirmed before the item changes hands.

steps.action: **Leave promptly and update the listing.** Do not count cash in public for longer than needed; mark the item sold after leaving if possible.
steps.expect: you exit safely and the marketplace status reflects the sale.

recipes.verification: The handoff occurs at the agreed public location, payment is verified in your own possession or account, the buyer receives only the sold item, and the listing is marked sold or unavailable.

recipes.title: negotiate with a marketplace buyer
recipes.name: negotiate-with-a-marketplace-buyer
recipes.goal: You negotiate with a buyer using a clear minimum price, safe communication, and firm payment terms so the sale closes without avoidable risk.

steps.action: **Classify the buyer message.** Identify whether it is a specific question, serious offer, lowball, scam pattern, or logistics request.
steps.expect: you know whether to engage, counter, or ignore.

steps.action: **Check your numbers before replying.** Recalculate fees, shipping, travel, bundle value, and your minimum net.
steps.expect: a firm acceptable range is ready.

steps.action: **Respond with facts and boundaries.** Answer legitimate questions and state price, pickup/shipping, and payment terms clearly.
steps.expect: the buyer understands what is negotiable.

steps.action: **Counter once with a reasoned offer.** If the buyer is below your target but above possible floor, counter with a specific price and deadline.
steps.expect: there is a concrete next price, not vague haggling.

steps.action: **Keep communication on-platform.** Decline requests to move to text, email, wire, gift cards, or external payment.
steps.expect: the negotiation record remains protected.

steps.action: **Confirm the complete deal.** Price, included items, payment method, pickup time/location or shipping address, and who pays shipping must all be explicit.
steps.expect: both sides have the same agreement in writing.

steps.action: **Accept the offer or schedule handoff.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* before accepting, confirm the final net is above your floor and the payment method is safe.
steps.expect: the platform shows an accepted offer or the meetup plan is set.

steps.action: **Close or walk away.** If the buyer changes terms, pressures you, or fails to commit, move to the next buyer.
steps.expect: you either have a safe sale path or no obligation to that buyer.

recipes.verification: The buyer has agreed in writing to a final price, included items, payment method, and handoff or shipping plan that keeps your expected net proceeds at or above your minimum.

recipes.title: price an item to sell fast
recipes.name: price-an-item-to-sell-fast
recipes.goal: You set a marketplace price that is low enough to sell quickly but still above your minimum acceptable net proceeds.

steps.action: **Define your deadline and floor.** Decide when the item must sell and the minimum net amount you will accept.
steps.expect: a clear speed target and walk-away number.

steps.action: **Research sold prices.** Find recent completed sales for the same item in similar condition and location or shipping terms.
steps.expect: a sold-price range, not just asking prices.

steps.action: **Calculate net proceeds.** Subtract platform fees, payment fees, shipping subsidies, packaging, travel, and expected discounts.
steps.expect: a realistic net amount at several price points.

steps.action: **Adjust for condition and completeness.** Price lower for damage, missing parts, no box, weak battery, odors, or uncertain compatibility.
steps.expect: your price reflects buyer risk.

steps.action: **Choose a fast-sale price.** Set the listing below the median comparable sold price while staying above your floor.
steps.expect: the price is visibly competitive against similar listings.

steps.action: **Build in offer strategy.** [BRANCH: firm price for urgent low-hassle sale | slightly higher price with room to negotiate]
steps.expect: your public price and private acceptance range are defined.

steps.action: **Check total buyer cost.** Include shipping, taxes, pickup effort, or delivery fees in the buyer's perspective.
steps.expect: the all-in price remains attractive.

steps.action: **Publish or update the listing.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm net proceeds and minimum before making the price live.
steps.expect: the listing shows the chosen price and terms.

steps.action: **Monitor early signal.** After the first view/message window, compare interest against deadline.
steps.expect: you know whether the price is working.

recipes.verification: The item is listed at a price with calculated net proceeds at or above your minimum, below or competitive with recent comparable sold prices, and aligned with the required sale deadline.

recipes.title: remove a sold listing everywhere
recipes.name: remove-a-sold-listing-everywhere
recipes.goal: You close every public copy of a sold item listing so no new buyer can purchase, message, or reasonably expect availability.

steps.action: **Confirm the sale is final enough to close listings.** Check payment status, handoff status, and any cancellation window.
steps.expect: the item is no longer available for another buyer.

steps.action: **Open your listing tracker or account dashboards.** Identify every marketplace, social post, classified ad, forum post, and cross-listing tool entry.
steps.expect: a complete list of public listing locations.

steps.action: **Mark the original sale platform correctly.** Use the platform's sold, shipped, completed, or fulfilled status rather than deleting an order record.
steps.expect: the platform records the transaction state without removing needed evidence.

steps.action: **End active copies on other marketplaces.** Choose sold, unavailable, paused, ended, or delete according to each site's options. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* deleting may remove messages and listing evidence; preserve order records before deletion.
steps.expect: no remaining marketplace copy can be purchased.

steps.action: **Update social and community posts.** Edit the title or first line to "Sold" or remove the post if that is the group's norm.
steps.expect: people browsing the post see the item is unavailable.

steps.action: **Reply to pending serious inquiries.** Send a short message that the item has sold and do not keep taking backup offers unless the original sale can still fail.
steps.expect: active buyers are not left waiting for an unavailable item.

steps.action: **Check search and saved links.** Open each old listing URL in a signed-out or private window where possible.
steps.expect: each link shows sold, unavailable, removed, or inaccessible.

steps.action: **Archive proof and cleanup reminders.** Save receipts, tracking, buyer messages, and platform confirmation until the return or dispute period ends.
steps.expect: records are available if a dispute or tax question appears later.

recipes.verification: Every known listing URL or post for the sold item shows sold, unavailable, ended, deleted, or private, and there are no active checkout buttons or pending unanswered buyer commitments.

recipes.title: reprice an unsold listing
recipes.name: reprice-an-unsold-listing
recipes.goal: You diagnose why a listing has not sold and adjust price, terms, or presentation so it has a realistic path to sale without dropping below your minimum.

steps.action: **Record current performance.** Note days listed, views, saves, messages, offers, current price, and total buyer cost.
steps.expect: a baseline for deciding what to change.

steps.action: **Refresh comparable sales.** Search recent sold listings for the same item, condition, location, and shipping terms.
steps.expect: current market value is known.

steps.action: **Diagnose the blocker.** Compare price, photos, title, description, shipping, pickup distance, and condition disclosure against sold comps.
steps.expect: the most likely reason for no sale is identified.

steps.action: **Recalculate your floor.** Include fees, shipping, packaging, storage cost, and urgency.
steps.expect: a revised minimum acceptable net.

steps.action: **Choose the adjustment.** [BRANCH: lower price | improve photos/title | offer bundle | add shipping or local pickup | accept offers]
steps.expect: a specific change tied to the blocker.

steps.action: **Apply the reprice or listing edit.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm the new visible price and net proceeds before saving because buyers can act immediately.
steps.expect: the live listing reflects the updated price or terms.

steps.action: **Message active watchers when appropriate.** Use platform tools to send an offer or price-drop notification without pressuring buyers off-platform.
steps.expect: interested buyers receive the updated offer.

steps.action: **Set a next review date.** Decide when to lower again, bundle, donate, trade in, or remove the item.
steps.expect: the listing has a clear next action if it remains unsold.

recipes.verification: The live listing has an updated price or terms based on current sold comps, expected net proceeds remain at or above your floor, and a dated next action is set if it still does not sell.

recipes.title: resell an event ticket legally
recipes.name: resell-an-event-ticket-legally
recipes.goal: You resell an event ticket only where resale is allowed, price it within legal and platform limits, and transfer it through a verifiable ticketing workflow.

steps.action: **Verify the ticket is transferable or resellable.** Check the ticket issuer's transfer/resale buttons, event rules, delivery date, and venue restrictions.
steps.expect: the ticket account shows resale or transfer is allowed, or you know it is not allowed.

steps.action: **Check legal and platform price limits.** Confirm face-value caps, fee disclosure rules, geographic restrictions, and marketplace rules for the event location.
steps.expect: your maximum legal listing price is clear.

steps.action: **Choose an authorized resale channel.** Prefer the original issuer's resale exchange or a marketplace that supports verified transfer for that event.
steps.expect: the chosen platform can deliver the ticket to the buyer legitimately.

steps.action: **Set a compliant net price.** Include platform fees and any legal cap; record the minimum net proceeds you will accept.
steps.expect: the listing price does not exceed applicable limits and meets your floor if sold.

steps.action: **Create the ticket listing accurately.** Enter event name, date, section, row, seat if allowed, quantity, restrictions, and delivery method. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* a buyer may purchase immediately; confirm the event, seat, price, and quantity before listing.
steps.expect: the resale listing is live or pending review with correct details.

steps.action: **Monitor sale status and avoid duplicate sales.** Do not list the same ticket on multiple platforms unless inventory is synchronized and allowed.
steps.expect: the ticket has only one active sale path.

steps.action: **Transfer only through the platform workflow.** After sale, complete the issuer or marketplace transfer to the buyer's verified email/account. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* once transferred, the buyer controls entry; transfer only after the platform confirms the sale.
steps.expect: the ticket shows transferred, delivered, or sale complete.

steps.action: **Confirm payout and archive proof.** Save resale confirmation, transfer proof, payout amount, and original purchase record.
steps.expect: payout is received or scheduled and records are retained.

recipes.verification: The resale platform shows the ticket sold and delivered/transferred to the buyer, the original ticket is no longer usable in your account, and payout is received or scheduled within the platform's stated amount.

recipes.title: run a garage sale
recipes.name: run-a-garage-sale
recipes.goal: You organize, advertise, price, and run a garage sale so unwanted items convert to cash without unsafe meetups, pricing chaos, or unresolved cleanup.

steps.action: **Check local rules and choose the sale window.** Confirm whether permits, time limits, sign restrictions, or neighborhood rules apply, then pick a date with a rain backup.
steps.expect: a permitted sale date, start time, end time, and backup plan.

steps.action: **Sort items into sell, donate, discard, and keep piles.** Remove recalled, unsafe, counterfeit, personal-data-bearing, or legally restricted items.
steps.expect: only sale-eligible items remain in the sell pile.

steps.action: **Price items before sale day.** Use simple tiers, visible stickers, and bundle pricing for low-value goods; mark high-value items individually.
steps.expect: each item or category has a clear price, plus a private minimum for negotiable items.

steps.action: **Prepare payment handling.** Start with change, decide whether to accept payment apps, and set one person as cashier.
steps.expect: cash box, change, and accepted payment methods are ready.

steps.action: **Advertise with boundaries.** Post the sale date, hours, general location, item highlights, and photos on approved local channels; avoid posting private household details beyond what buyers need.
steps.expect: the sale is findable and the public listing shows correct hours and location.

steps.action: **Stage the sale for browsing and supervision.** Put valuables near the cashier, group similar items, keep walkways clear, and block access to private areas.
steps.expect: buyers can browse without entering private spaces or handling unsupervised valuables.

steps.action: **Open on time and track sales.** Greet buyers, answer condition questions honestly, and record high-value sales or digital payments.
steps.expect: transactions are logged enough to reconcile cash and payment-app receipts.

steps.action: **Negotiate without losing control.** [BRANCH: fixed-price item | negotiable item] Decline offers below your private floor and use bundle discounts to move low-value inventory.
steps.expect: accepted prices meet your minimums or the item remains available.

steps.action: **Confirm payment before releasing goods.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* once a buyer leaves with an item, recovery is unlikely; count cash or verify digital payment inside your own app first.
steps.expect: the buyer leaves only after real payment is confirmed.

steps.action: **Close, reconcile, and dispose of leftovers.** Remove signs, count cash, compare digital receipts, mark donations, and secure unsold valuables.
steps.expect: sale proceeds are counted, signs are down, and every leftover item has a next destination.

recipes.verification: The sale has ended, all public signs/posts are removed or updated, proceeds are counted, digital payments are confirmed in your accounts, and all unsold items are assigned to keep, donate, relist, or discard.

recipes.title: sell a domain name
recipes.name: sell-a-domain-name
recipes.goal: You sell a domain name through a safe marketplace or escrow workflow and transfer control only after payment is secured.

steps.action: **Confirm ownership and transfer eligibility.** Check registrar status, expiration date, transfer lock, recent registration or transfer restrictions, and contact email access.

steps.action: **Research comparable sales and set a floor.** Use marketplace comps, keyword quality, extension, age, traffic, and renewal cost to choose asking price and minimum acceptable net.

steps.action: **Choose a protected sale channel.** [BRANCH: fixed-price marketplace | broker | independent escrow] Compare fees, payout timing, transfer support, and buyer verification.

steps.action: **Prepare the listing or escrow terms.** Enter exact domain spelling, price, included assets if any, transfer method, buyer fees, and timeline.
steps.expect: sale terms match your intended domain and net proceeds.

steps.action: **Publish or send the transaction invitation.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* a buyer may rely on these terms; confirm spelling, price, and included rights before posting.
steps.expect: the listing is live or the escrow transaction is open.

steps.expect: the platform confirms funds are secured according to its rules.

steps.action: **Transfer the domain only through the agreed method.** [BRANCH: same-registrar push | inter-registrar transfer] Unlock only if needed, provide auth code through the platform if required, or push to the buyer's account. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* domain control can be hard to recover; transfer only after protected payment confirmation.
steps.expect: the registrar shows the domain pending transfer or moved to the buyer.

steps.action: **Confirm completion and payout.** Monitor escrow/marketplace release, payout method, and final registrar status.
steps.expect: the domain is no longer in your account and proceeds are paid or scheduled.

steps.action: **Remove old sale listings and records.** End duplicate listings, update DNS if required, and archive receipts for taxes.
steps.expect: the domain is no longer advertised by you as available.

recipes.verification: The domain has transferred to the buyer or their registrar account, the marketplace or escrow transaction shows complete, and your payout is received or formally scheduled for the agreed net amount.

recipes.title: sell a gift card you wont use
recipes.name: sell-a-gift-card-you-wont-use
recipes.goal: You convert an unwanted gift card into cash or usable value while avoiding invalid-card disputes, unsafe buyers, and illegal or suspicious resale patterns.

steps.action: **Verify the balance directly.** Check the balance through the merchant's official site, app, or phone number printed on the card.

steps.action: **Confirm resale is allowed.** Read card terms and marketplace rules for restrictions on resale, partial balances, or promotional cards.

steps.action: **Compare selling options.** Check exchange sites, payout methods, fees, buyer protection, and expected discount from face value.

steps.action: **Complete platform verification.** Upload required proof or enter card details only into the trusted exchange checkout flow.

steps.action: **Confirm the sale terms.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* verify payout amount, buyer protection, delivery method, and refund rules before releasing card codes.
steps.expect: you have a binding sale or exchange order.

steps.action: **Transfer the card securely.** Send digital codes only through the platform or hand over a physical card only after confirmed payment.
steps.expect: the buyer receives the card through the agreed protected channel.

steps.action: **Track payout and dispute window.** Keep balance screenshots, receipts, and transfer confirmation until payment settles.
steps.expect: payout is received and no invalid-card claim is open.

recipes.verification: The gift card has been transferred through the chosen channel, the seller payout has settled at or above your minimum, and there is no open invalid-card or payment-reversal dispute.

recipes.title: sell clothes on depop
recipes.name: sell-clothes-on-depop
recipes.goal: You create a Depop listing that attracts the right buyer, keeps style and condition claims honest, and ships only through a protected payment flow.

steps.action: **Define the style and buyer.** Identify era, cut, brand, fabric, color, and searchable aesthetic terms without making false vintage or designer claims.

steps.action: **Measure and photograph.** Capture front/back, worn or flat-lay view, tags, fabric, flaws, and measurements in notes.

steps.expect: a list price and private minimum after fees and shipping.

steps.action: **Release payout records.** Track sale price, fees, shipping cost, and payout availability.
steps.expect: proceeds are available or scheduled and the order has no dispute.

recipes.verification: The Depop order shows paid and shipped with valid tracking, the payout is available or scheduled above your minimum, and there is no open dispute or off-platform obligation.

recipes.title: sell clothes on poshmark
recipes.name: sell-clothes-on-poshmark
recipes.goal: You list clothing on Poshmark with accurate sizing and condition details, accept a profitable offer, and ship within the platform's seller-protection rules.

steps.action: **Inspect and prep the garment.** Check seams, stains, odors, missing buttons, pilling, and fabric care tags.

steps.action: **Measure key dimensions.** Record bust/chest, waist, hips, inseam, rise, length, sleeve, heel height, or bag dimensions as relevant.

steps.action: **Research Poshmark comps.** Search sold listings for brand, size, style name, and condition.

steps.action: **Create the listing.** Enter brand, category, size, condition, original price if known, listing price, and style keywords.
steps.expect: the listing draft is searchable and complete.

steps.action: **Write the description.** Include measurements, fabric, care, condition, flaws, smoke/pet disclosures if relevant, and what is included.

steps.action: **Publish and share the listing.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm price, size, and flaw disclosure before publishing because offers may arrive immediately.
steps.expect: the item appears in your closet.

steps.action: **Evaluate offers by net proceeds.** Use Poshmark's fee estimate and shipping discounts before accepting or countering.
steps.expect: any accepted price is above your minimum.

recipes.title: sell handmade goods online
recipes.name: sell-handmade-goods-online
recipes.goal: You publish a handmade-goods listing with clear materials, pricing, production time, and shipping terms so buyers know exactly what they will receive.

steps.action: **Calculate true cost.** Add materials, labor time, packaging, platform fees, payment fees, shipping subsidies, and expected waste.

steps.action: **Check marketplace rules.** Verify handmade, vintage, personalization, safety, and intellectual-property policies.

recipes.title: sell old books online

steps.action: **List or accept buyback offers.** [BRANCH: marketplace listing | instant buyback] Enter exact edition, condition, photos for flaws, price, shipping, and handling time. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* accepting a buyback quote or publishing a listing creates buyer expectations; confirm edition and condition first.
steps.expect: books are live for sale or accepted into a buyback shipment.

recipes.title: sell on ebay

recipes.title: sell sneakers on a resale app

steps.action: **Publish or accept the sale.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm SKU, size, condition, payout, and shipping deadline before committing because cancellation can trigger penalties.
steps.expect: the sale or listing is active in the app.

steps.action: **Pack exactly what was sold.** Include matching shoes, box, laces, tags, and accessories promised in the listing; protect the original box inside an outer box.
steps.expect: package contents match the order record.

steps.action: **Ship to the app or buyer address provided.** Use the platform label and scan the package before the deadline. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* verify the order in the app before shipping.
steps.expect: tracking is active and linked to the sale.

steps.action: **Track authentication and payout.** Respond quickly if the app requests more information.
steps.expect: authentication passes or the app explains a specific issue; payout is released after approval.

recipes.verification: The resale app shows the sneakers shipped with platform tracking, authentication accepted when required, and payout released or scheduled at or above your minimum.

recipes.title: sell used textbooks
recipes.name: sell-used-textbooks
recipes.goal: You sell a used textbook through the channel with the best net return, while accurately disclosing edition, ISBN, condition, and access-code status.

steps.action: **Record textbook identifiers.** Find ISBN-13, title, author, edition, publisher, and whether it is international, loose-leaf, rental, or instructor edition.
steps.expect: you can match the exact book buyers need.

steps.action: **Check access-code status.** Determine whether codes, online homework, CDs, or lab manuals are included and unused.
steps.expect: the listing will not falsely imply access.

steps.action: **Inspect condition.** Note highlighting, writing, torn pages, water damage, binding issues, and missing pages.
steps.expect: a condition grade with specific defects.

steps.action: **Compare buyback and marketplace values.** Check campus bookstore, online buyback sites, and sold marketplace listings after fees and shipping.
steps.expect: the best net channel is identified.

steps.action: **Choose sale method.** [BRANCH: instant buyback for speed | marketplace listing for higher expected price | local student sale for no shipping]
steps.expect: a chosen channel that matches urgency and payout target.

steps.action: **Create the listing or buyback quote.** Enter exact ISBN, condition, supplements, price, and shipping terms.
steps.expect: the platform accepts the book details or provides a quote.

steps.action: **Confirm payout and deadline.** For buyback, verify quote expiration and condition rules; for marketplace, set a minimum after fees.
steps.expect: expected proceeds meet your threshold.

steps.action: **Commit to the sale.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm ISBN, edition, access-code disclosure, payout, and shipping deadline before accepting a buyback quote or purchase.
steps.expect: you have an order, quote, or buyer commitment.

steps.action: **Ship or hand off the book.** Package to prevent corner damage, use tracking when required, or meet locally in a public campus spot.
steps.expect: the book is delivered to the buyer or buyback processor.

steps.action: **Confirm payment.** Track buyback inspection or marketplace delivery until funds settle.
steps.expect: payout posts with no condition dispute.

recipes.verification: The textbook is delivered or accepted by the buyback processor, and the final payout is posted at or above your target with no open edition, condition, or access-code dispute.

recipes.title: ship a sold item safely
recipes.name: ship-a-sold-item-safely
recipes.goal: You pack and ship a sold marketplace item so it reaches the buyer with tracking, proof, and seller-protection requirements satisfied.

steps.action: **Verify the order in-platform.** Confirm paid status, buyer name, platform-provided address, shipping service, and deadline.
steps.expect: the order is eligible to ship.

steps.action: **Match the item to the order.** Check model, size, color, serial, condition, quantity, and included accessories.
steps.expect: the package contents match the listing exactly.

steps.action: **Document condition before packing.** Photograph or video the item working, flaws already disclosed, accessories, and serial/model details if appropriate.
steps.expect: evidence exists for disputes.

steps.action: **Choose protective packaging.** Use the right box, padding, waterproofing, anti-static bag, or double-boxing for fragile or valuable items.
steps.expect: the item cannot shift or break under normal handling.

steps.action: **Weigh and measure accurately.** Enter packed weight and dimensions before buying a label.
steps.expect: postage matches the actual parcel.

steps.action: **Buy or print the correct label.** Use the marketplace label when seller protection depends on it, and ship only to the order address.
steps.expect: tracking is linked to the order.

steps.action: **Seal and label the package.** Remove old barcodes, attach the label flat, and include any required invoice or customs form.
steps.expect: the carrier can scan and route the package.

steps.action: **Hand the parcel to the carrier.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm payment and address before release because you cannot retrieve the package easily after acceptance.
steps.expect: you receive an acceptance scan, receipt, or pickup confirmation.

steps.action: **Upload or verify tracking.** Ensure the marketplace order shows shipped and tracking is active.
steps.expect: buyer and platform can see shipment progress.

steps.action: **Keep records until the dispute window ends.** Save photos, receipt, label, tracking, and messages.
steps.expect: evidence is ready if the buyer claims damage or non-receipt.

recipes.verification: The marketplace order shows shipped with valid tracking to the platform-provided address, the carrier has accepted the package, and packing/order evidence is saved until payout and dispute windows close.

recipes.title: source items for resale
recipes.name: source-items-for-resale
recipes.goal: You buy resale inventory only when expected profit, demand, legality, and operational effort justify the risk.

steps.action: **Choose a narrow sourcing target.** Define category, brands, sizes/models, condition limits, and platforms where you can resell.
steps.expect: you know what to buy and what to ignore.

steps.action: **Set a buy formula.** Estimate resale price, platform fees, shipping, repairs, cleaning, supplies, taxes, and desired profit margin.
steps.expect: a maximum buy price for each target item.

steps.action: **Check legal and platform restrictions.** Avoid counterfeit goods, recalled items, restricted products, stolen goods, and categories you cannot authenticate.
steps.expect: the sourcing list is compliant.

steps.action: **Search sourcing channels.** [BRANCH: thrift stores | estate sales | clearance racks | local marketplaces | auctions | wholesale lots] Compare asking prices against your formula.
steps.expect: candidate items are filtered by profit potential.

steps.action: **Inspect before buying.** Check condition, completeness, authenticity markers, serials, odors, damage, and sell-through demand.
steps.expect: only items meeting condition and authenticity thresholds remain.

steps.action: **Negotiate or walk away.** Offer at or below your maximum buy price and leave if the seller will not meet it.
steps.expect: purchase price preserves expected profit.

steps.action: **Buy and record inventory.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm max price, resale legality, and condition before paying because liquidation may be difficult.
steps.expect: purchased item has cost, source, date, and notes recorded.

steps.action: **Prepare for listing.** Clean, test, photograph, and store the item safely.
steps.expect: inventory is ready to list without losing parts or condition evidence.

steps.action: **Review sourcing performance.** Track sell-through time, profit, defects, returns, and dead inventory.
steps.expect: future sourcing decisions improve from actual results.

recipes.verification: Each sourced item has a recorded purchase price at or below its maximum buy price, passes legality and condition checks, and has an expected net profit margin after fees, shipping, and prep costs.

recipes.title: trade in an old phone
recipes.name: trade-in-an-old-phone
recipes.goal: You trade in an old phone for a quoted credit or payout after backing up, wiping, and documenting the device so your data and value are protected.

steps.action: **Identify the phone accurately.** Record model, storage, color, carrier lock status, IMEI/serial, battery health, and visible damage.
steps.expect: the quote matches the actual device.

steps.action: **Check eligibility and value.** Compare trade-in offers from carrier, manufacturer, retailer, and buyback sites, including promo requirements.
steps.expect: a best offer and fallback offer are selected.

steps.action: **Confirm ownership and account status.** Pay off financed balances if required, remove activation locks, and verify the phone is not reported lost or stolen.
steps.expect: the phone is eligible for transfer.

steps.action: **Back up personal data.** Save photos, contacts, messages, authenticator accounts, and app data to your new phone or cloud.
steps.expect: needed data is accessible somewhere else.

steps.action: **Document condition.** Take photos/video of the phone working, IMEI screen if safe, battery health, body condition, and packaging.
steps.expect: evidence exists before trade-in inspection.

steps.action: **Accept the trade-in quote.** Enter exact device details and choose mail-in or in-store trade-in. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm estimated value, promo terms, and data backup before committing.
steps.expect: a trade-in order, label, appointment, or confirmation number is issued.

steps.action: **Remove accounts and wipe the phone.** Sign out of device accounts, disable activation lock, remove SIM/eSIM where appropriate, and factory reset.
steps.expect: the phone boots to setup or trade-in-ready state with no personal account attached.

steps.action: **Send or hand over the phone.** [BRANCH: mail-in, pack securely and get carrier acceptance scan | in-store, obtain written receipt before leaving]
steps.expect: you have proof the device entered the trade-in process.

steps.action: **Monitor inspection and credit.** Watch for revised value notices and respond before deadlines.
steps.expect: final value is accepted or you choose return if the revision is too low.

steps.action: **Confirm payout or bill credit.**
steps.expect: credit, gift card, or cash payout posts to the promised account.

recipes.verification: The old phone is wiped and removed from your accounts, the trade-in provider confirms receipt and final acceptance, and the promised credit or payout has posted or is scheduled in writing.

recipes.title: write a listing that sells
recipes.name: write-a-listing-that-sells
recipes.goal: You write a marketplace listing that is searchable, honest, and specific enough to attract serious buyers while preventing avoidable disputes.

steps.action: **Name the item precisely.** Use brand, model, size, color, material, year, compatibility, or part number in the title.
steps.expect: buyers searching for the exact item can find it.

steps.action: **Lead with the essential facts.** State condition, what is included, whether it works, and why it is being sold if helpful.
steps.expect: the first lines answer the buyer's main questions.

steps.action: **Disclose flaws plainly.** List scratches, stains, missing parts, repairs, odors, defects, or limitations without softening them.
steps.expect: the description matches the photos and reduces disputes.

steps.action: **Add measurements and compatibility.** Include dimensions, size, model numbers, system requirements, or fit notes where relevant.
steps.expect: buyers can verify the item fits their need.

steps.action: **State sale terms.** Include price firmness, pickup area, shipping availability, payment method, bundle options, and whether holds are allowed.
steps.expect: buyers know how to complete the purchase.

steps.action: **Avoid risky claims.** Do not use brand names, authenticity claims, medical claims, or warranty promises you cannot support.
steps.expect: the listing is accurate and policy-compliant.

steps.action: **Format for scanning.** Use short paragraphs or bullets, no keyword stuffing, and no aggressive all-caps pressure.
steps.expect: the listing is easy to read on mobile.

steps.action: **Review before publishing.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* confirm title, price, condition, flaws, and terms before listing goes live.
steps.expect: the listing can be published without immediate corrections.

recipes.verification: The listing text includes exact item identity, condition, flaws, included items, price, and transaction terms, and it can be published with photos that support every material claim.

recipes.title: order prescription glasses online
recipes.name: order-prescription-glasses-online
recipes.goal: Order prescription glasses online with correct prescription, pupillary distance, frame fit, lens options, and return terms.

steps.action: **Check prescription validity.** Confirm sphere, cylinder, axis, add power if needed, expiration date, and doctor contact.
steps.expect: the prescription can legally and accurately be used.

steps.action: **Measure pupillary distance.** Use the doctor's value, old glasses order, or retailer measurement tool with repeat checks.
steps.expect: PD is recorded for single or dual-eye entry.

steps.action: **Choose frame size.** Compare lens width, bridge, temple length, frame width, and lens height to glasses that fit.
steps.expect: candidate frames should sit comfortably.

steps.action: **Select lens type.** [BRANCH: single vision | progressive | bifocal | readers] match the prescription and daily use.
steps.expect: the lens category fits the prescription.

steps.action: **Choose lens options carefully.** Compare index, anti-reflective coating, scratch resistance, blue-light claims, photochromic tint, polarization, and sunglasses.
steps.expect: upgrades are useful rather than automatic.

steps.action: **Review insurance and discounts.** Check out-of-network reimbursement, HSA or FSA eligibility, coupons, shipping, taxes, and return fees.
steps.expect: total cost and reimbursement path are known.

steps.action: **Enter prescription exactly.** Copy plus or minus signs, decimals, cylinder, axis, add, prism, and PD into the order form.
steps.expect: the order preview matches the prescription.

steps.action: **Place the order.** Confirm frame, prescription, PD, lens options, shipping address, and return policy before payment. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* custom prescription lenses may have limited refunds, so verify all numbers before paying.
steps.expect: confirmation shows all prescription and product details.

steps.action: **Check glasses on arrival.** Test distance, reading, frame fit, lens defects, and headaches or distortion over the allowed adjustment period.
steps.expect: you know whether to keep, adjust, or remake them.

recipes.verification: The order confirmation matches the prescription and PD, and the delivered glasses provide clear vision and acceptable fit within the return or remake window.

recipes.title: price match an item
recipes.name: price-match-an-item
recipes.goal: Get a retailer to match a lower eligible price before or shortly after buying an item.

steps.action: **Find the store policy.** Search the retailer name plus "price match policy" and open the current official policy page.
steps.expect: you know which competitors, item types, and time windows are eligible.

steps.action: **Match the exact item.** Compare model number, color, size, quantity, warranty, and included accessories.
steps.expect: the lower-priced item is identical, not just similar.

steps.action: **Confirm stock and seller.** Check that the competitor has the item in stock and sold by an eligible seller, not a third-party marketplace seller if excluded.
steps.expect: the competitor page shows available inventory and an acceptable seller.

steps.action: **Capture proof.** Save a screenshot or keep the live page, ad, or printed flyer with date, price, and item details visible.
steps.expect: you can show the lower price without searching again at the counter or chat window.

steps.action: **Choose the right channel.** [BRANCH: before purchase | after purchase] ask at checkout before paying, or contact support within the policy's adjustment window after purchase.
steps.expect: you are using the channel the policy allows.

steps.action: **Ask plainly.** Say, "Can you price match this exact item to this competitor price?" and show the proof.
steps.expect: the associate or agent checks the policy instead of treating it like a coupon.

steps.action: **Review exclusions.** Watch for exclusions such as clearance, bundles, membership prices, coupon prices, flash sales, refurbished items, or financing offers.
steps.expect: you know why the match is approved or denied.

steps.action: **Confirm the final amount.** Check tax, shipping, and any price adjustment line before agreeing. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* if you pay, confirm the adjusted total first because refunds may require a separate return or support case.
steps.expect: the receipt or cart shows the matched price.

steps.action: **Keep the receipt.** Save the receipt and proof until the return window closes.
steps.expect: you can follow up if the adjustment disappears or posts incorrectly.

recipes.verification: The final receipt, cart, or refund confirmation shows the lower matched item price for the exact item.

recipes.title: read a warranty
recipes.name: read-a-warranty
recipes.goal: Understand what a product warranty covers, what it excludes, how long it lasts, whether registration matters, and how to make a claim.

steps.action: **Identify the warranty issuer.** Determine whether coverage comes from the manufacturer, retailer, third-party plan, or card benefit.
steps.expect: you know who would handle a claim.

steps.action: **Find the exact product version.** Match model number, region, bundle, and purchase channel to the warranty text.
steps.expect: the warranty applies to your item.

steps.action: **Read what is covered.** Look for defects in materials, workmanship, parts, labor, shipping, replacement, and repair.
steps.expect: covered problems are listed in plain notes.

steps.action: **Read what is excluded.** Check accidental damage, misuse, wear items, batteries, consumables, water damage, commercial use, and unauthorized repair.
steps.expect: likely denial reasons are known.

steps.action: **Confirm the term.** Note start date, duration, and whether coverage differs for parts, labor, or accessories.
steps.expect: you know the last claim date.

steps.action: **Check registration rules.** [BRANCH: required | optional] see whether registration is mandatory, extends coverage, or only speeds service.
steps.expect: any registration deadline is known.

steps.action: **Keep the receipt.** Save receipt, order number, serial number, photos, and warranty PDF in one place.
steps.expect: proof of purchase is retrievable.

steps.action: **Map the claim path.** Note website, phone number, service center, shipping responsibility, and required troubleshooting.
steps.expect: you know the first claim step.

steps.action: **Compare with return policy.** If the product is new and faulty, check whether return or exchange is faster than warranty repair.
steps.expect: you choose the better remedy.

recipes.verification: You can state the warranty issuer, covered defects, exclusions, term end date, registration requirement, saved receipt location, and claim path.

recipes.title: read reviews critically
recipes.name: read-reviews-critically
recipes.goal: Use reviews to judge whether an item is likely to work for your specific need, instead of trusting the star rating alone.

steps.action: **Start with the distribution.** Note the number of reviews, the average rating, and whether the ratings cluster at five stars or spread across the range.
steps.expect: you can say whether the score comes from many buyers or only a thin sample.

steps.action: **Sort by most recent.** Read the newest five to ten reviews before reading the top-rated ones.
steps.expect: recent comments mention current packaging, shipping, sizing, software version, or seller behavior.

steps.action: **Filter for critical reviews.** [BRANCH: one-star and two-star | three-star] read complaints first, then compare them with neutral reviews.
steps.expect: you know the most common reasons buyers regret the purchase.

steps.action: **Search for your use case.** Search terms like "wide feet", "apartment", "Android", "leaks", "battery", or the model name of your device.
steps.expect: at least one review addresses a situation close to yours, or none do.

steps.action: **Check verified purchases.** Give more weight to reviews marked verified, especially when a product attracts fans, rivals, or free-sample reviewers.
steps.expect: the strongest evidence comes from people who likely bought the item.

steps.action: **Spot fake-review patterns.** Look for repeated phrases, many reviews on the same date, vague praise, photos that look reused, or accounts reviewing unrelated items in the same wording.
steps.expect: suspicious clusters are separated from detailed buyer reports.

steps.action: **Compare volume with quality.** Treat 4.7 stars from 30 vague reviews as weaker than 4.3 stars from 2,000 detailed reviews with consistent pros and cons.
steps.expect: your confidence reflects both sample size and detail.

steps.action: **Read seller responses and updates.** Notice whether the seller solves defects, blames customers, or ignores repeated problems.
steps.expect: you know how the seller behaves after the sale.

steps.action: **Make a buy, wait, or skip decision.** Write the top reason to buy and the top reason not to buy in one sentence each.
steps.expect: the decision is based on evidence you can point to.

recipes.verification: You can name the three most repeated strengths, the three most repeated complaints, and whether those complaints matter for your use case.

recipes.title: register a product warranty
recipes.name: register-a-product-warranty
recipes.goal: Register a product warranty with the correct manufacturer, serial number, proof of purchase, deadline, and saved confirmation.

steps.action: **Find the official page.** Use the manufacturer's website from the product manual or packaging, not a search ad alone.
steps.expect: the domain matches the manufacturer.

steps.action: **Check the registration deadline.** Read whether registration must happen within a certain number of days after purchase.
steps.expect: you know whether timing affects coverage.

steps.action: **Locate product identifiers.** Find model number, serial number, IMEI, VIN, or batch code on the product, label, box, or app.
steps.expect: identifiers are copied accurately.

steps.action: **Prepare proof of purchase.** Save receipt, invoice, order confirmation, or photo showing date, seller, and price.
steps.expect: the upload file is readable.

steps.action: **Enter owner details minimally.** Provide required name, email, country, and address fields, skipping optional marketing fields when possible.
steps.expect: the form accepts required identity details.

steps.action: **Enter purchase details.** [BRANCH: online order | store purchase] provide seller, date, price if required, and upload proof if requested.
steps.expect: purchase information matches the receipt.

steps.action: **Submit after review.** Confirm product, serial, purchase date, and email before submitting. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* a wrong serial or email can make future claims harder, so verify them before submission.
steps.expect: the registration succeeds or gives a confirmation screen.

steps.action: **Store confirmation.** Save email, confirmation number, warranty PDF, receipt, and serial photo together.
steps.expect: claim materials are retrievable later.

steps.action: **Opt out where appropriate.** Turn off marketing emails or data sharing options that are not required for warranty service.
steps.expect: registration remains active without extra promotions.

recipes.verification: You have a saved warranty registration confirmation linked to the correct product serial number, purchase date, seller, and proof of purchase.

recipes.title: return a gift without a receipt
recipes.name: return-a-gift-without-a-receipt
recipes.goal: Return or exchange a gift without a receipt while preserving privacy for the gift giver when possible.

steps.action: **Identify the seller.** Check tags, packing slip, shipping label, store brand, barcode, or order gift note.
steps.expect: you know where to try the return first.

steps.action: **Read the return policy.** Find no-receipt, gift, holiday, final-sale, opened-item, and ID requirements.
steps.expect: you know whether refund, exchange, or store credit is possible.

steps.action: **Check item condition.** Keep tags, accessories, manuals, packaging, and serial numbers together.
steps.expect: the item meets the policy condition.

steps.action: **Decide privacy level.** [BRANCH: keep giver private | ask giver for receipt] use store lookup or exchange first, or ask for receipt if value is high.
steps.expect: you choose the least awkward workable path.

steps.action: **Bring proof and ID.** Take the item, packaging, any gift message, and ID if required.
steps.expect: the store can scan or look up the item.

steps.action: **Ask for gift return options.** Request exchange, store credit, or gift-card refund without returning money to the giver if policy allows.
steps.expect: the associate explains available value and method.

steps.action: **Review the offered amount.** Check whether value is current selling price, lowest recent price, or original purchase price.
steps.expect: you know the refund value before accepting.

steps.action: **Accept or decline.** Complete the return only if the amount and method are acceptable. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* once refunded to store credit or exchanged, the original item may not be recoverable.
steps.expect: receipt shows store credit, exchange, or declined return.

recipes.verification: You have a return receipt showing store credit, exchange, refund method, or written denial, and the gift giver's payment details were not exposed unless you chose that path.

recipes.title: return a product
recipes.name: return-a-product
recipes.goal: A purchased product is returned to the seller and the refund (or exchange) is confirmed back to your payment method.

steps.action: **Read the return policy for this order.** Find window length, condition requirements, who pays return shipping, and refund method.
steps.expect: you can state deadline, cost, and refund destination before acting.

steps.action: **Initiate the return in the order system.** Order history → the item → "Return or replace". Select a reason code honestly — "defective" and "changed mind" trigger different flows and fee treatment.
steps.expect: the system offers return methods (drop-off, pickup, mail) and shows any deducted fees.

steps.action: **Choose refund or exchange, and a return method.** [BRANCH: refund | exchange for variant]
steps.expect: a return authorization with a shipping label, QR code, or drop-off instructions.

steps.action: **Pack the item.** Original packaging and all accessories/tags included; photograph the item and the packed box as evidence of condition.
steps.expect: photos stored; box sealed with the label or QR ready.

steps.action: **Hand the package over.** Drop off at the designated carrier/locker or hand to pickup. Get a receipt or scan confirmation. ⚠️ *Irreversible:* once handed over you cannot retrieve contents — double-check you didn't include unrelated items.
steps.expect: tracking shows the return in transit within a day.

steps.action: **Track until received.**
steps.expect: tracking flips to "delivered to seller", then the order system marks the return received.

steps.action: **Confirm the refund.**
steps.expect: refund issued notice, and the amount posts to the original payment method within the stated processing window (often 5–10 business days).

recipes.verification: The refund for the expected amount is visible as posted (not pending) on the payment method's statement, and the order history shows the return closed.

recipes.title: sell an item online
recipes.name: sell-an-item-online
recipes.goal: You list a used item honestly and priced to actually sell, communicate safely with buyers, and complete the handover (in person or shipped) so you get paid without getting scammed.

steps.action: **Research the real selling price before listing.** Search completed/sold listings for the same item and condition, not just active asking prices.
steps.expect: a realistic price range from what items actually sold for.

steps.action: **Clean the item and gather everything that adds value.** Cables, manuals, box, proof of purchase.
steps.expect: the item is presentable and its extras are staged.

steps.action: **Photograph it well and honestly.** Multiple angles in natural light on a plain background, plus close-ups of every flaw (scratches, wear, missing bits).
steps.expect: a set of sharp photos that show both the good and the defects.

steps.action: **Write a specific, honest listing.** Include brand, model, exact condition, dimensions/specs, what is included, and every known flaw. Honesty here prevents disputes later.
steps.expect: a description a stranger could rely on without surprises.

steps.action: **Set the price with room for offers.** Price slightly above your floor if the platform expects haggling; note your true walk-away number privately.
steps.expect: a listed price plus a private minimum you will accept.

steps.action: **Publish and respond promptly to genuine questions.**
steps.expect: the listing is live and searchable; inquiries arrive.

steps.action: **Screen buyers and refuse off-platform payment tricks.** Ignore "I'll send my shipper", overpayment, or requests to move to gift cards or wire. Keep payment inside the platform's protected system.
steps.expect: you are dealing only with normal buyers paying through the platform.

steps.action: **Complete the handover safely.** [BRANCH: local sale, meet in a public, camera-covered spot (or a police-station safe-exchange zone) in daylight, ideally bring a friend, take cash or confirm instant payment cleared before handing over | shipping sale, ship only after payment clears, to the platform-provided address, with tracking and a photo of the packed item] ⚠️ *Irreversible:* once the item leaves your hands you cannot recover it, so confirm real payment first.
steps.expect: item handed over only after confirmed payment; tracking uploaded if shipped.

steps.action: **Confirm funds landed and close out.**
steps.expect: the money is in your account (not just "pending" in a spoofed screenshot) and the listing is marked sold.

recipes.verification: The item has been handed over or shipped with tracking, confirmed payment has actually settled in your account, and the listing is closed with no open dispute.

recipes.title: shop a sale without overspending
recipes.name: shop-a-sale-without-overspending
recipes.goal: Use a sale to buy things you already need without letting discounts expand the total spend.

steps.action: **Write the need list first.** List categories and maximum quantities before opening the sale page or entering the store.
steps.expect: the list exists before you see sale banners.

steps.action: **Set a hard total.** Choose the maximum amount you will spend including tax, shipping, and fees.
steps.expect: there is a number that stops the trip.

steps.action: **Check normal prices.** Look up the usual price for each target item from your receipts, a price tracker, or another retailer.
steps.expect: you know whether the sale price is real.

steps.action: **Compare unit price.** Convert to price per ounce, count, wear, use, or month as appropriate.
steps.expect: the larger or sale package is actually cheaper per unit if you buy it.

steps.action: **Apply the full-price test.** Ask, "Would I buy this at full price within the next month?"
steps.expect: impulse items fail unless they solve a real need.

steps.action: **Cart then wait.** Put candidates in the cart, leave for at least 10 minutes, then remove weak items before checkout.
steps.expect: the cart total drops or stays within the hard total.

steps.action: **Check return and storage limits.** Do not bulk-buy perishables, sizes, or final-sale items unless you can use them.
steps.expect: every item has a place and a realistic use date.

steps.action: **Pay only after final review.** ⚠️ *Irreversible:* final-sale, personalized, or perishable sale items may not be returnable, so confirm quantity and return rules before payment.
steps.expect: the receipt total stays at or below your hard total.

recipes.verification: The final cart contains only pre-listed needs or full-price-test passes, and the total is at or below the hard budget.

recipes.title: track a delivery
recipes.name: track-a-delivery
